en-US.abandonedLot.json.Placemaker.Recipe.AbandonedLot.Descripti: A forgotten plot: broken foundations, rubble, weeds reclaiming the ground, a rotting fence.
en-US.abandonedLot.json.Placemaker.Abandoned.Name: Abandoned lot
en-US.abandonedLot.json.Placemaker.Abandoned.subtype.Tooltip: What happened here. Each type lays the lot out differently.
en-US.abandonedLot.json.Placemaker.Abandoned.overgrowth.Tooltip: How far wild plants have taken back the lot. They come from the edges and up through the cracks.
en-US.abandonedLot.json.Placemaker.Abandoned.rubble.Tooltip: Rubble around the collapse point: big piles near it, smaller chunks and dust further out.
en-US.abandonedLot.json.Placemaker.Abandoned.junk.Tooltip: Dumped tyres, barrels, pallets and carts, mostly near the street and the fence.
en-US.abandonedLot.json.Placemaker.Abandoned.graffiti.Tooltip: Graffiti decals on wall remnants and along the fence.
en-US.abandonedLot.json.Placemaker.Abandoned.foundations.Tooltip: Old concrete slabs of buildings that stood here.
en-US.abandonedLot.json.Placemaker.Abandoned.cracking.Tooltip: How badly the slabs are broken: more cracks, wider gaps, missing pieces.
en-US.abandonedLot.json.Placemaker.Abandoned.groundPaint.Tooltip: Paints bare dirt on the terrain (permanent, stays after removal).
en-US.abandonedLot.json.Placemaker.Abandoned.paintLayer.Tooltip: Which of the map's four extra terrain textures to paint.
en-US.abandonedLot.json.Placemaker.Abandoned.desirePaths.Tooltip: Worn dirt tracks where people cut across between the gaps in the fence.
en-US.abandonedLot.json.Placemaker.Abandoned.focus.Tooltip: Where the building came down: rubble is heaviest there.
en-US.abandonedLot.json.Placemaker.Abandoned.mounds.Tooltip: Raises the ground into rubble mounds around the collapse point (permanent terraform, blended to the edge).
en-US.abandonedLot.json.Placemaker.Abandoned.walls.Tooltip: Stretches of wall still standing on the edges of the foundations.
en-US.abandonedLot.json.Placemaker.Abandoned.youngTrees.Tooltip: Self-seeded saplings, mostly in the corners and along the fence.
en-US.abandonedLot.json.Placemaker.Abandoned.crackWeeds.Tooltip: Weeds growing up through the cracks of the slabs.
en-US.abandonedLot.json.Placemaker.Abandoned.fenceGaps.Tooltip: Share of fence panels that have fallen or been torn out (in stretches).
en-US.abandonedLot.json.Placemaker.Abandoned.shelters.Tooltip: Shacks and tarps around a fire in the most sheltered corner (at least four on a squatter camp).
en-US.abandonedLot.json.Placemaker.Abandoned.Issue.NoCampSpot: No sheltered spot was big enough for the camp.
en-US.abandonedLot.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Debris.Name: Debris & junk
en-US.abandonedLot.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Debris.mix.Tooltip: Junk (tyres, barrels, pallets), rubble, or both.
en-US.abandonedLot.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Debris.where.Tooltip: Dumped along the edges (over the fence) or scattered in the open.

en-US.addons.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Fountain.Name: Fountain
en-US.addons.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Fountain.apron.Tooltip: A round paved area around the fountain.
en-US.addons.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Fountain.Issue.Smaller: The fountain was made smaller to fit the free space.
en-US.addons.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Playground.Name: Playground
en-US.addons.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Playground.Issue.Smalle: The playground was made smaller to fit the free space.
en-US.addons.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Restrooms.Name: Restrooms
en-US.addons.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Picnic.Name: Picnic area
en-US.addons.json.Placemaker.AddOn.BigTrees.Name: Big trees
en-US.addons.json.Placemaker.AddOn.BigTrees.density.Toolti: Specimen trees per hectare, each standing alone on open lawn.
en-US.addons.json.Placemaker.AddOn.BigTrees.clearance.Tool: How far each big tree stays from paths, other trees and furniture.
en-US.addons.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Flowerbeds.Name: Flowerbeds
en-US.addons.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Flowerbeds.nearPaths.To: Prefer spots beside paths, where the flowers are seen.

en-US.adventurePlayground.json.Placemaker.Recipe.AdventurePlayground.De: Play zones by age round a shaded parents' hub: climbing, swings, splash pad, nature play on a mound.
en-US.adventurePlayground.json.Placemaker.AdvPlay.Name: Adventure playground
en-US.adventurePlayground.json.Placemaker.AdvPlay.style.Tooltip: The signature of the playground: which zone leads the layout.
en-US.adventurePlayground.json.Placemaker.AdvPlay.ageZones.Tooltip: Separate zones for toddlers, juniors and teens (toddlers nearest the parents), one mixed zone, or toddler zones only.
en-US.adventurePlayground.json.Placemaker.AdvPlay.equipment.Tooltip: Total pieces of play equipment, shared between the play zones.
en-US.adventurePlayground.json.Placemaker.AdvPlay.clearance.Tooltip: Free fall space kept between pieces of equipment.
en-US.adventurePlayground.json.Placemaker.AdvPlay.ground.Tooltip: Ground under the equipment: sand, rubber-look paving, bark (dirt) or plain grass.
en-US.adventurePlayground.json.Placemaker.AdvPlay.waterPlay.Tooltip: A splash pad with jets and a chain of stepping pools.
en-US.adventurePlayground.json.Placemaker.AdvPlay.pools.Tooltip: Small water-look pools with stones, trailing away from the splash pad.
en-US.adventurePlayground.json.Placemaker.AdvPlay.naturePlay.Tooltip: Logs, boulders, a mound and a willow tunnel instead of manufactured equipment.
en-US.adventurePlayground.json.Placemaker.AdvPlay.mound.Tooltip: Raises a round mound in the nature zone, blended to the ground at its foot (permanent terrain change).
en-US.adventurePlayground.json.Placemaker.AdvPlay.tunnel.Tooltip: Two rows of bushes forming a green tunnel to crawl and run through.
en-US.adventurePlayground.json.Placemaker.AdvPlay.benches.Tooltip: Benches on the hub and at each zone, always facing the play.
en-US.adventurePlayground.json.Placemaker.AdvPlay.shade.Tooltip: Shade for parents and children: a shelter on the hub, trees behind each zone, both or none.
en-US.adventurePlayground.json.Placemaker.AdvPlay.sightlines.Tooltip: No trees or bushes between the parents' hub and any play zone.
en-US.adventurePlayground.json.Placemaker.AdvPlay.hubTables.Tooltip: A few picnic tables just outside the parents' hub.
en-US.adventurePlayground.json.Placemaker.AdvPlay.wornGround.Tooltip: Paints trampled ground round each zone (permanent terrain texture).
en-US.adventurePlayground.json.Placemaker.AdvPlay.paintLayer.Tooltip: Which of the map's terrain layers (1–4) to paint.
en-US.adventurePlayground.json.Placemaker.AdvPlay.fence.Tooltip: A fence round the playground (gaps at the entrances) and a low fence round the toddler zone.
en-US.adventurePlayground.json.Placemaker.AdvPlay.Feature.kickabout.Too: An open lawn with two small goals for ball games.
en-US.adventurePlayground.json.Placemaker.AdvPlay.Issue.NoZones: No play zone fits in this area.
en-US.adventurePlayground.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Kickabout.Name: Kickabout lawn
en-US.adventurePlayground.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Kickabout.length.Toolti: Length of the open lawn; it is 60 % as wide.
en-US.adventurePlayground.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Kickabout.Issue.Smaller: The kickabout lawn was made smaller to fit the free space.

en-US.amenities.json.Placemaker.Feature.volleyball.Tooltip: A 16 × 8 m sand volleyball court with a net, run-off sand and benches for spectators.
en-US.amenities.json.Placemaker.Feature.basketball.Tooltip: An asphalt basketball half-court with a hoop facing the path, optionally fenced and floodlit.
en-US.amenities.json.Placemaker.Feature.tableTennis.Tooltip: Outdoor ping-pong tables on a paved pad, with benches at the ends.
en-US.amenities.json.Placemaker.Feature.chess.Tooltip: Chess tables on paving under a shelter or shade trees, optionally with a giant board.
en-US.amenities.json.Placemaker.Feature.fitness.Tooltip: Outdoor gym equipment on a soft surface: a cluster, a calisthenics row or a ring.
en-US.amenities.json.Placemaker.Feature.splashPad.Tooltip: A round paved pad with water jets for children, ringed by benches for the parents.
en-US.amenities.json.Placemaker.Feature.bandstand.Tooltip: A bandstand at the end of a lawn with arcs of benches, or a gazebo in a ring of flowerbeds.
en-US.amenities.json.Placemaker.Feature.dogRun.Tooltip: A fenced dog run with a gate towards the path, agility items, benches and dog bins.
en-US.amenities.json.Placemaker.Feature.noticeboard.Tooltip: A community noticeboard or park map with a bench, a bin and a lamp, by default near an entrance.
en-US.amenities.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Volleyball.Name: Volleyball pit
en-US.amenities.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Volleyball.lines.Toolti: Marking decals at the court's base lines (when marking decals are installed).
en-US.amenities.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Volleyball.Issue.Smalle: The volleyball court was made smaller than 16 × 8 m to fit.
en-US.amenities.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Basketball.Name: Basketball court
en-US.amenities.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Basketball.court.Toolti: A half-court with one hoop (15 × 14 m) or a full court with two (28 × 15 m, needs a long space).
en-US.amenities.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Basketball.lines.Toolti: Marking decals at the key and the centre circle (when marking decals are installed).
en-US.amenities.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Basketball.fence.Toolti: A fence round the court with one gate towards the path.
en-US.amenities.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Basketball.Issue.Half: A full court does not fit here; a half-court was built.
en-US.amenities.json.Placemaker.AddOn.TableTennis.Name: Table tennis
en-US.amenities.json.Placemaker.AddOn.TableTennis.shade.Toolt: One shade tree off a corner, away from the play space.
en-US.amenities.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Chess.Name: Outdoor chess
en-US.amenities.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Chess.giant.Tooltip: A 5 × 5 m board laid in the paving with benches for the players.
en-US.amenities.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Chess.shade.Tooltip: A shelter over the tables when one is installed, otherwise two shade trees.
en-US.amenities.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Fitness.Name: Fitness stations
en-US.amenities.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Fitness.layout.Tooltip: An outdoor gym cluster, a calisthenics row along one side, or a ring of stations facing outwards.
en-US.amenities.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Fitness.surface.Tooltip: A rubber, bark or gravel surface under the equipment.
en-US.amenities.json.Placemaker.AddOn.SplashPad.Name: Splash pad
en-US.amenities.json.Placemaker.AddOn.SplashPad.shade.Tooltip: Two shade trees on the side away from the path.
en-US.amenities.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Bandstand.Name: Bandstand
en-US.amenities.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Bandstand.kind.Tooltip: A bandstand plays to a lawn of benches; a gazebo sits in the middle of a ring of flowerbeds.
en-US.amenities.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Bandstand.rows.Tooltip: Arcs of benches facing the bandstand (all round a gazebo).
en-US.amenities.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Bandstand.flowers.Toolt: A ring of flowerbeds round the structure, open towards the audience.
en-US.amenities.json.Placemaker.AddOn.DogRun.Name: Dog run
en-US.amenities.json.Placemaker.AddOn.DogRun.agility.Tooltip: Jumps, tunnels and weave poles spread over the run.
en-US.amenities.json.Placemaker.AddOn.DogRun.smallDogs.Toolti: A fenced-off third of the run for small dogs.
en-US.amenities.json.Placemaker.AddOn.DogRun.amenities.Toolti: Dog bins and drinking posts by the gate.

en-US.amphitheatre.json.Placemaker.Recipe.Amphitheatre.Descripti: Open-air venue: seating stepped into the terrain in an arc facing a stage, aisles, a top promenade — or an open-air cinema, a bandstand lawn, a concert meadow, a speakers' corner.
en-US.amphitheatre.json.Placemaker.Amphitheatre.Name: Amphitheatre
en-US.amphitheatre.json.Placemaker.Amphitheatre.style.Tooltip: Changes the extras: statues by the stage, a projection booth, string lights round a bandstand, a crowd barrier and mixing tent at a concert.
en-US.amphitheatre.json.Placemaker.Amphitheatre.rows.Tooltip: Rows of seats on a site of 0.6 ha. A bigger site gets more rows (up to twice as many, on gentler steps), so the bowl fills it.
en-US.amphitheatre.json.Placemaker.Amphitheatre.span.Tooltip: How far the seating wraps round the stage. 360° puts the stage in the middle.
en-US.amphitheatre.json.Placemaker.Amphitheatre.terrain.Tooltip: Dig: the stage sits in a pit and the rows step back up to the ground. Build: the rows are raised towards a crest. Slope: keep the ground (the stage goes to the low side). None: flat.
en-US.amphitheatre.json.Placemaker.Amphitheatre.rowDepth.Tooltip: Depth of one row (tread) from front to back.
en-US.amphitheatre.json.Placemaker.Amphitheatre.rise.Tooltip: Height step from one row to the next.
en-US.amphitheatre.json.Placemaker.Amphitheatre.seats.Tooltip: What stands on the rows: benches, deckchairs, picnic tables, or bare lawn steps.
en-US.amphitheatre.json.Placemaker.Amphitheatre.aisles.Tooltip: Paths climbing the rows from the stage to the promenade.
en-US.amphitheatre.json.Placemaker.Amphitheatre.rowShape.Tooltip: Curved rows round the stage, or straight rows facing a screen.
en-US.amphitheatre.json.Placemaker.Amphitheatre.stageSize.Toolti: Radius of the stage area; the first row starts 2 m behind it.
en-US.amphitheatre.json.Placemaker.Amphitheatre.stageSide.Toolti: Auto: the low side on a slope, else away from the road. Road: by the road. Far: away from the road. Low: lowest point. Centre: in the middle.
en-US.amphitheatre.json.Placemaker.Amphitheatre.orchestra.Toolti: A paved floor round the stage in front of the first row.
en-US.amphitheatre.json.Placemaker.Amphitheatre.backdrop.Tooltip: An arc of trees behind the stage.
en-US.amphitheatre.json.Placemaker.Amphitheatre.promenade.Toolti: A path along the top of the seating, with side paths down to the stage.
en-US.amphitheatre.json.Placemaker.Amphitheatre.kiosks.Tooltip: Refreshment kiosks behind the promenade (food trucks at a concert meadow).
en-US.amphitheatre.json.Placemaker.Amphitheatre.lightTowers.Tool: Light towers at the front corners and behind the seating.
en-US.amphitheatre.json.Placemaker.Amphitheatre.Issue.NoRoom: No room for even one row of seating — a stage on a lawn instead.

en-US.animalPark.json.Placemaker.Recipe.AnimalPark.Description: A visitor attraction of fenced enclosures: petting farm, paddocks, horse paddock with arena, deer park or aviary garden, with a walk, hub and viewpoints.
en-US.animalPark.json.Placemaker.AnimalPark.Name: Animal park
en-US.animalPark.json.Placemaker.AnimalPark.Issue.NoPens: No room for enclosures: try fewer pens, another walk layout or a larger area.
en-US.animalPark.json.Placemaker.AnimalPark.kind.Tooltip: Sets the pen ground, shelters and which animals the spawners call for.
en-US.animalPark.json.Placemaker.AnimalPark.pens.Tooltip: How many fenced pens the space between the walks is cut into.
en-US.animalPark.json.Placemaker.AnimalPark.shelters.Tooltip: A shelter, stable or hutch at the back of each pen, away from the walk.
en-US.animalPark.json.Placemaker.AnimalPark.walkIn.Tooltip: Petting and bird pens get an open gate on the walk side so visitors can go in.
en-US.animalPark.json.Placemaker.AnimalPark.arena.Tooltip: A fenced sand arena with a course of jumps, cut out before the pens.
en-US.animalPark.json.Placemaker.AnimalPark.aviaries.Tooltip: Bird cages beside the walks, outside the pens.
en-US.animalPark.json.Placemaker.AnimalPark.animals.Tooltip: Animal spawners in the pens (only where the game has suitable spawners).
en-US.animalPark.json.Placemaker.AnimalPark.pond.Tooltip: A pond inside the largest enclosure. Permanent terrain change.
en-US.animalPark.json.Placemaker.AnimalPark.layout.Tooltip: Loop: a walk round the inside of the edge with pens in the middle. Spine: a central walk with pens either side. Trail: winding paths with pens between them.
en-US.animalPark.json.Placemaker.AnimalPark.hub.Tooltip: A yard by the entrance with a barn, kiosk and picnic tables; features such as the playground go in its middle.
en-US.animalPark.json.Placemaker.AnimalPark.viewpoints.Tooltip: Bench pairs on the walk facing the largest pens (a lookout in a deer park).
en-US.animalPark.json.Placemaker.AnimalPark.benchSpacing.Toolt: Benches beside the walks every so many metres; 0 = none.
en-US.animalPark.json.Placemaker.AnimalPark.shadeTrees.Tooltip: Trees per hectare, inside the pens and round the walks.
en-US.animalPark.json.Placemaker.AnimalPark.woodland.Tooltip: Wooded pasture inside the pens: share of the ground under trees.
en-US.animalPark.json.Placemaker.AnimalPark.hedgerow.Tooltip: A hedge just inside the outline, with gaps at the entrances.
en-US.animalPark.json.Placemaker.AnimalPark.wornGround.Tooltip: Paints trampled earth inside each pen gate. Permanent.
en-US.animalPark.json.Placemaker.AnimalPark.groundLayer.Toolti: Which of the map's four extra terrain textures to paint (depends on the map).
en-US.animalPark.json.Placemaker.AnimalPark.terrain.Tooltip: Gentle mounds (goat hills, deer park) or a level site; blended back to the original ground at the edge. Permanent.

en-US.beach.json.Placemaker.Beach.Name: Beach
en-US.beach.json.Placemaker.Recipe.Beach.Description: Real sand painted into the terrain from the water's edge, blending into the grass behind; umbrellas in loose rows, lifeguard posts, a promenade with short accesses onto landings, dunes behind.
en-US.beach.json.Placemaker.Beach.style.Tooltip: Sandy, rocky (dirt texture with sand pockets), river, cove (wild dunes) or volleyball beach. Each lays out the shore differently.
en-US.beach.json.Placemaker.Beach.waterSide.Tooltip: Which side of the area faces the water. Automatic finds the water; otherwise pick a side (north = +Z on the map).
en-US.beach.json.Placemaker.Beach.beachDepth.Tooltip: How far the sand reaches inland from the waterline to the back path.
en-US.beach.json.Placemaker.Beach.umbrellas.Tooltip: Umbrella sets (an umbrella with loungers) per hectare of sand.
en-US.beach.json.Placemaker.Beach.layout.Tooltip: Loose groups like a public beach, or tidy rows like a resort lido.
en-US.beach.json.Placemaker.Beach.carve.Tooltip: Grade the ground into one smooth gentle slope down to the waterline and on under the water (permanent): it lowers the ground and only fills small hollows; cliffs are left natural.
en-US.beach.json.Placemaker.Beach.slope.Tooltip: Gradient of the carved beach. Real sand beaches are 2–8 %.
en-US.beach.json.Placemaker.Beach.wetBand.Tooltip: Strip along the water kept free of umbrellas (boats, rocks and tide pools go here).
en-US.beach.json.Placemaker.Beach.sandSurface.Tooltip: Also lay a sand surface over the beach (hard edged). Off by default: the sand is painted into the terrain instead. Useful on custom maps whose terrain layer 4 is not sand.
en-US.beach.json.Placemaker.Beach.sandBlend.Tooltip: How far the sand texture fades into the ground behind the beach. Small = a crisp edge at the promenade, large = sand drifting far inland.
en-US.beach.json.Placemaker.Beach.sandReach.Tooltip: Carry the sand and the graded slope past the outline down to the real water and on under it (see Sand under water), so the beach meets the water even when the area was drawn short of it (permanent).
en-US.beach.json.Placemaker.Beach.paint.Tooltip: Paint the beach into the terrain texture like the game's Paint texture tool, with a soft blend (permanent).
en-US.beach.json.Placemaker.Beach.paintLayer.Tooltip: Which terrain texture to paint: 1 dry grass, 2 lush grass, 3 dirt, 4 sand (on vanilla maps; custom maps may differ).
en-US.beach.json.Placemaker.Beach.backdrop.Tooltip: What lies behind the back path: dunes with marram grass, a lawn, woods, or nothing.
en-US.beach.json.Placemaker.Beach.duneDepth.Tooltip: How deep the dune belt (or the planted strip) is behind the back path.
en-US.beach.json.Placemaker.Beach.duneFence.Tooltip: Short fence runs along the dune foot where the ground is even, with gaps where paths cross. Off by default: vanilla has no timber sand fence.
en-US.beach.json.Placemaker.Beach.grassDensity.Tooltip: How much grass and scrub grows on the dunes or along the backdrop edge.
en-US.beach.json.Placemaker.Beach.backPath.Tooltip: A path behind the sand, parallel to the water, with benches, lamps, huts and kiosks.
en-US.beach.json.Placemaker.Beach.accessSpacing.Tooltip: Distance between the short accesses from the promenade down onto the sand.
en-US.beach.json.Placemaker.Beach.benchSpacing.Tooltip: Benches facing the sea along the back path. 0 = none.

en-US.carYard.json.Placemaker.CarYard.Name: Car yard
en-US.carYard.json.Placemaker.Recipe.CarYard.Description: A car demolition yard: wrecks in long double rows nose to the aisle, parts sorted into bays, an office and parking at the gate.
en-US.carYard.json.Placemaker.CarYard.style.Tooltip: What the yard is for. Each type has its own layout, not just different props.
en-US.carYard.json.Placemaker.CarYard.fill.Tooltip: How full the yard is. It fills from the main aisle outward, row by row, so a part-full yard still looks tidy.
en-US.carYard.json.Placemaker.CarYard.aisle.Tooltip: Width of the drive aisles between the blocks: wide enough for trucks and forklifts.
en-US.carYard.json.Placemaker.CarYard.office.Tooltip: The office row and the gate booth by the way in.
en-US.carYard.json.Placemaker.CarYard.parking.Tooltip: A row of parked cars on the other side of the way in.
en-US.carYard.json.Placemaker.CarYard.weighbridge.Tooltip: A concrete weighbridge across the way in, just inside the gate.
en-US.carYard.json.Placemaker.CarYard.edge.Tooltip: What lines the inside of the fence: a screen of trees, a wall of concrete blocks, a two-high wall of containers, a wall of scrap cars piled two and three high (back and sides only), a bund of big boulders bedded into the ground (open at the gates), or plain ground.
en-US.carYard.json.Placemaker.CarYard.fence.Tooltip: A security fence round the yard with a gap at the gate.
en-US.carYard.json.Placemaker.CarYard.ground.Tooltip: Concrete lays a slab over the yard. Gravel and dirt paint the ground itself: mud along the aisles, oily ground round the heaps and machines, dry grass along the fence. The aisles are always asphalt and whatever stands on the ground gets a concrete pad.
en-US.carYard.json.Placemaker.CarYard.level.Tooltip: Levels the yard to one pad, blended back to the ground at the outline. Permanent.
en-US.carYard.json.Placemaker.CarYard.paint.Tooltip: Paints the terrain: the yard ground, mud where the wheels go, oil-soaked ground round the heaps, worn dirt under the rows, dry grass at the fence. Permanent.
en-US.carYard.json.Placemaker.CarYard.spoil.Tooltip: Mounds of dirt in the corners no block fits, painted, with a dead tree and dead bushes on them. Raises real terrain. Permanent.
en-US.carYard.json.Placemaker.CarYard.banks.Tooltip: Long banks of earth along the back and side fence where there is room, spoil worked into their tops (rubble, boulders, now and then a heap of clay), stones and a dead bush at their foot. Raises real terrain. Permanent.
en-US.carYard.json.Placemaker.CarYard.stones.Tooltip: How many stones lie spilled round the heaps, the work pad and the banks, and along the dirt roads.
en-US.carYard.json.Placemaker.CarYard.rubble.Tooltip: Concrete, board and mixed rubble worked into the ground in drifting patches: only the tops show, like a yard that has been driven over for years. Never on the roads or a concrete yard; less in a yard laid out in blocks.

en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.Commercial.lot.Tooltip: A small car park on the street, in the middle of the frontage.
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.Commercial.Issue.NoStreet: No existing street runs along the area: shops need one to face (it became a small park).
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.Commercial.Issue.NoLot: There was no room for a parking lot.
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.Commercial.Issue.Fallback: The chosen layout did not fit here, so a simpler one was used.

en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.StripMall.frontage.Tooltip: How much of the street the strip mall takes; it stays centred.

en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.ShoppingPlaza.sideLots.Toolti: Parking lots on the street beside the shops.
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.Recipe.OutdoorMall.Descriptio: A pedestrian shopping street with shops on both sides, a plaza at its end and parking beside it.
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.OutdoorMall.Name: Outdoor mall
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.OutdoorMall.style.Tooltip: Promenade: one pedestrian street. Grand: a wide one. Loop: a pedestrian loop with shops on both sides. Lifestyle centre: the street, plaza and green inside a ring drive, lots outside, paseos through the rows.

en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.OutdoorMall.spineLength.Toolt: Longest the pedestrian street may run into the area.
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.OutdoorMall.sideLots.Tooltip: Parking lots on the street beside the shops.
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.Recipe.ShopsPark.Description: A park woven between shop plots, with a small car park.
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.ShopsPark.Name: Shops & park
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.ShopsPark.layout.Tooltip: How the shop plots sit between the park and the street.
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.ShopsPark.parkStyle.Tooltip: Style of the park between the shops.
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.Commercial.streetShops.Toolti: Off: the land along the city streets is planted and every shop faces the site's own lanes and lot. On: rows of shops face the streets around the site.
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.Commercial.outerRow.Tooltip: A band along each street round the site, a whole cell clear of the lanes. It is planted; shops grow on it only with "Street-facing shops" on.
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.Commercial.outerZone.Tooltip: Zone of the plots facing the streets: high density for big buildings on the main frontage.
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.Commercial.outerDepth.Tooltip: How deep the plots facing the streets reach (whole 8 m cells).
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.OutdoorMall.playground.Toolti: A small playground in the green behind the plaza.
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.Recipe.HighStreet.Description: A market street: two pedestrian lanes with a market, café terrace or garden between them and small shops facing it.
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.HighStreet.Name: High street
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.HighStreet.centre.Tooltip: What fills the strip between the two lanes.
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.HighStreet.lane.Tooltip: Pedestrian streets, or shared alleys cars may use.
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.HighStreet.centreWidth.Toolti: Width of the market strip between the lanes.
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.HighStreet.streetLength.Toolt: Longest the high street may run into the area; a street at the back makes it a through street.
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.HighStreet.grain.Tooltip: Fine: one-cell frontages (many little shops). Coarse: three cells.
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.HighStreet.sideLots.Tooltip: Parking lots on the main street beside the shops, joined to the high street by paseos.
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.Recipe.RetailPark.Description: A few big stores round one big shared car park, with pad sites on the streets.
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.RetailPark.Name: Retail park
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.RetailPark.style.Tooltip: Horseshoe: stores on three sides of the lot. Twin terraces: two rows facing each other across the lot, the road running through.
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.RetailPark.unit.Tooltip: How wide each store plot is along the road.
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.RetailPark.road.Tooltip: The service road round the lot: a small road, or an alley.
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.RetailPark.pads.Tooltip: Small plots on the streets beside the stores (a café, a drive-through).
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.Recipe.MallPark.Description: A park in the middle of the block, ringed by a lane and small shops facing it; bigger shops on the streets outside.
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.MallPark.Name: Mall park
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.MallPark.parkStyle.Tooltip: Style of the park in the middle.
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.MallPark.loop.Tooltip: The lane round the park: an alley, or a pedestrian street (car-free).
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.Recipe.MallDistrict.Descripti: The whole block as shops: big plots on the streets, a grid of lanes inside lined with small shops, squares and courtyard gardens.
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.MallDistrict.Name: Mall district
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.MallDistrict.lanes.Tooltip: Mixed: alleys from the street, pedestrian lanes across. Alleys: cars everywhere. Pedestrian: car-free.
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.MallDistrict.blocks.Tooltip: How far apart the lanes are: compact blocks are all shops, spacious ones keep a courtyard garden in the middle.
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.MallDistrict.squares.Tooltip: Small squares at the central crossing of the lanes.
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.MallDistrict.parkingBlocks.To: Surface car parks mixed in among the blocks of shops: none, about one block in three, or one in two.
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.Commercial.entrances.Tooltip: Where cars and people come in, as in the parking tool: two-way, way in, way out, driveway (a real junction), driveway in/out, footpath. Nothing joins the streets anywhere else; the drives, lots and walks are planned from these.
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.Commercial.Reason.NeedsEntran: Place at least one entrance for cars: a two-way entrance or driveway, or one way in and one way out. Footpaths are for people only.
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.Commercial.Issue.NoLayout: The shops do not fit this area (too small or too thin) and no street runs along it. Draw a bigger area up to a street.
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.Commercial.Issue.NoRoom: Not enough room for a parking lot with shops: it needs about {0} m from the entrance side to the back of the shops, and about 40 m along that side. Draw a bigger or less narrow area, or put the car entrance on another side.
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.Commercial.Issue.FootpathBehi: Footpath {0} is behind the row of shops: people can't get through the shops to the parking. Move it to the parking side.
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.Commercial.Issue.TooSteep: Too steep for shops here (about {0} % slope): the shops' lane would climb too steeply. Draw the area on gentler ground, or longer across the slope.
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.Commercial.Issue.EntranceNoLa: Entrance {0} leads to no lane of the shops: move it to a side the drives can reach.
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.Commercial.Issue.EntranceNoSt: Entrance {0} has no street within reach: move it next to a street.
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.Commercial.square.Tooltip: A square in the middle of the row of shops, facing the parking lot: a café plaza, a small park, a garden or a pond. The shops stand either side of it.
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.Commercial.walkways.Tooltip: A tree-lined walk through the lot to the shops (with a crosswalk), a promenade through the planted frontage, and the walks in from footpath entrances.
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.Commercial.pocketPlaza.Toolti: A small paved plaza where the walk meets the shops: café tables, benches, planters, a fountain on big sites.
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.Commercial.bikes.Tooltip: Bike racks at the plazas, or bike paths through the frontage as well.
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.Commercial.foodTrucks.Tooltip: Food carts parked at the plazas and along the walks.
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.Commercial.pads.Tooltip: Small plots out by the main street for a restaurant or a bank, with planting round them.
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.Commercial.landscape.Tooltip: Designed: groves with shrubs, flowerbeds at the drives and mulch under the trees on every left-over strip. Plain: lawn and a row of trees.
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.Commercial.hedges.Tooltip: A low hedge between the parking and the street.
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.Commercial.buildingSites.Tool: Dirt painted on the front of every plot, so a plot not built yet reads as a site. Painted ground is permanent.
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.Commercial.plotTrees.Tooltip: Trees and shrubs at the back of each plot, on painted lawn. A building that grows clears what is in its way; the rest stays green.
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.Commercial.wornGround.Tooltip: Paths worn into the lawn where people cut corners, mulch under the trees, worn ground where walks meet the street. Painted ground is permanent.
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.Commercial.water.Tooltip: A retention pond (permanent: the ground is dug), and rain gardens of wet-ground planting along the lots.
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.MallPark.loopRoad.Tooltip: Parking: a road with parked cars on both sides round the park (a town square). Alley: a quiet lane.
en-US.commercial.json.Placemaker.Commercial.lotMedian.Tooltip: How wide the planted strips between the rows of parking bays are: wider holds bigger trees.

en-US.constructionSite.json.Placemaker.ConstructionSite.Name: Construction site
en-US.constructionSite.json.Placemaker.ConstructionSite.subtype.Tool: What is being built: each type lays out its works zone differently.
en-US.constructionSite.json.Placemaker.ConstructionSite.workSize.Too: How much of the site the works zone (dig, road strip, rubble field, cut) takes.
en-US.constructionSite.json.Placemaker.ConstructionSite.depth.Toolti: Dig depth (foundation, trench, cut) or rubble and spoil height (demolition, earthworks). Permanent terrain change.
en-US.constructionSite.json.Placemaker.ConstructionSite.fence.Toolti: A fence round the whole site with truck-wide gates at the entrances.
en-US.constructionSite.json.Placemaker.ConstructionSite.compound.Too: Site offices, toilets and containers beside the haul road near the gate.
en-US.constructionSite.json.Placemaker.ConstructionSite.piles.Toolti: Sand, gravel and soil heaps per hectare, in clusters by the works.
en-US.constructionSite.json.Placemaker.ConstructionSite.stacks.Toolt: Pallets, pipes, rebar and bricks per hectare, in short rows.

en-US.constructionSite.json.Placemaker.ConstructionSite.Issue.NoRoom: Not enough room for the works zone here; the site gets only its yard.

en-US.constructionSite.json.Placemaker.AddOn.SpoilHeaps.raise.Toolti: Builds a real mound under each heap. Permanent terrain change.
en-US.constructionSite.json.Placemaker.AddOn.SpoilHeaps.paintLayer.T: Which of the map's four extra terrain textures to paint.
en-US.constructionSite.json.Placemaker.AddOn.WorkLights.Name: Work lights
en-US.constructionSite.json.Placemaker.AddOn.WorkLights.generators.T: A small generator beside each light tower.

en-US.containerYard.json.Placemaker.ContainerYard.Name: Container yard
en-US.containerYard.json.Placemaker.Recipe.ContainerYard.Descript: Shipping containers kept the way a real yard keeps them: stacks in long blocks, rows doors-to-aisle, truck aisles, an office and parking at the gate.
en-US.containerYard.json.Placemaker.ContainerYard.style.Tooltip: What the yard is for. Each type has its own layout, not just different props.
en-US.containerYard.json.Placemaker.ContainerYard.fill.Tooltip: How full the yard is. It fills from the main aisle outward, row by row, so a part-full yard still looks tidy.
en-US.containerYard.json.Placemaker.ContainerYard.aisle.Tooltip: Width of the drive aisles between the blocks: wide enough for trucks and forklifts.
en-US.containerYard.json.Placemaker.ContainerYard.office.Tooltip: The office row and the gate booth by the way in.
en-US.containerYard.json.Placemaker.ContainerYard.parking.Tooltip: A row of parked cars on the other side of the way in.
en-US.containerYard.json.Placemaker.ContainerYard.weighbridge.Too: A concrete weighbridge across the way in, just inside the gate.
en-US.containerYard.json.Placemaker.ContainerYard.edge.Tooltip: What lines the inside of the fence: a screen of trees, a wall of concrete blocks, a two-high wall of containers, a wall of scrap cars piled two and three high (back and sides only), a bund of big boulders bedded into the ground (open at the gates), or plain ground.
en-US.containerYard.json.Placemaker.ContainerYard.fence.Tooltip: A security fence round the yard with a gap at the gate.
en-US.containerYard.json.Placemaker.ContainerYard.ground.Tooltip: Concrete lays a slab over the yard. Gravel and dirt paint the ground itself: mud along the aisles, oily ground round the heaps and machines, dry grass along the fence. The aisles are always asphalt and whatever stands on the ground gets a concrete pad.
en-US.containerYard.json.Placemaker.ContainerYard.level.Tooltip: Levels the yard to one pad, blended back to the ground at the outline. Permanent.
en-US.containerYard.json.Placemaker.ContainerYard.paint.Tooltip: Paints the terrain: the yard ground, mud where the wheels go, oil-soaked ground round the heaps, worn dirt under the rows, dry grass at the fence. Permanent.
en-US.containerYard.json.Placemaker.ContainerYard.spoil.Tooltip: Mounds of dirt in the corners no block fits, painted, with a dead tree and dead bushes on them. Raises real terrain. Permanent.
en-US.containerYard.json.Placemaker.ContainerYard.banks.Tooltip: Long banks of earth along the back and side fence where there is room, spoil worked into their tops (rubble, boulders, now and then a heap of clay), stones and a dead bush at their foot. Raises real terrain. Permanent.
en-US.containerYard.json.Placemaker.ContainerYard.stones.Tooltip: How many stones lie spilled round the heaps, the work pad and the banks, and along the dirt roads.
en-US.containerYard.json.Placemaker.ContainerYard.rubble.Tooltip: Concrete, board and mixed rubble worked into the ground in drifting patches: only the tops show, like a yard that has been driven over for years. Never on the roads or a concrete yard; less in a yard laid out in blocks.

en-US.core.json.Placemaker.Name: Placemaker
en-US.core.json.Placemaker.Issue.RecipeTooDeep: This design has too many nested layers.
en-US.core.json.Placemaker.Issue.UnknownLayer: Unknown layer "{0}" — is a mod missing?

en-US.dress.json.Placemaker.Dress.NoPacks: Decorative decals need decal asset packs; none found.
en-US.dress.json.Placemaker.Dress.dressAmount.Tooltip: How much wear, litter and stains dress what you build; 0 removes every decorative decal.
en-US.dress.json.Placemaker.Dress.dressStyle.Tooltip: How worn the painted ground looks.
en-US.dress.json.Placemaker.Dress.dressStyle.livedIn.Tool: Everyday use: worn verges and paths.
en-US.dress.json.Placemaker.Dress.dressStyle.gritty.Toolt: Neglected: heavy wear and bare ground.
en-US.dress.json.Placemaker.Dress.dressPaintWear.Tooltip: How much is painted into the ground texture as dressing: lawn variation, mulch under trees, worn path edges, worn patches at benches, play items and entrances, soft edges, pitch and pitch-site wear. Only where the bare ground shows (never under a surface, path or water). Permanent, like all ground paint; 0 paints nothing.
en-US.dress.json.Placemaker.Dress.dressDesirePaths.Toolti: Faint trodden lines where people cut corners between paths and walk across the lawn to benches and play items (painted into the ground texture).
en-US.dress.json.Placemaker.Dress.dressDesirePaths.Off: Only when Ground paint is on
en-US.dress.json.Placemaker.Dress.dressLawn.Tooltip: Painted terrain: the map's own grass with lush and dry patches, mulch and wear painted in (natural, lived-in). Grass surface: one even, manicured grass texture that hides the ground (formal; also the choice on desert or rocky maps).
en-US.dress.json.Placemaker.Dress.dressLawn.painted.Toolt: Bare terrain grass with painted variation and wear. Permanent paint.
en-US.dress.json.Placemaker.Dress.dressLawn.surface.Toolt: A manicured grass surface over the lawn (removed with the build).
en-US.dress.json.Placemaker.Dress.dressMulch.Tooltip: Dark forest-floor ground under every tree crown (soft and irregular; a neat round bed in a clean style).
en-US.dress.json.Placemaker.Dress.dressLawnTint.Tooltip: Lush patches in hollows, near water and in shade, dry patches on knolls (painted lawns only).
en-US.dress.json.Placemaker.Dress.dressPaintClear.Tooltip: Resets the ground texture inside the area to the plain terrain before painting — including any paint you made yourself there. Permanent.
en-US.dress.json.Placemaker.Dress.dressTrees.Tooltip: Leaves and needles under trees and shrubs.
en-US.dress.json.Placemaker.Dress.dressPaths.Tooltip: Leaves along path edges, worn verges, cracks and worn corners at junctions.
en-US.dress.json.Placemaker.Dress.dressPaved.Tooltip: Stains, cracks and puddles on paving, with scuffs by benches and splashes round fountains.
en-US.dress.json.Placemaker.Dress.dressParking.Tooltip: Oil in the bays, tyre marks at turns and entrances, repaired patches.
en-US.dress.json.Placemaker.Dress.dressPlay.Tooltip: Bare ground under play items and picnic tables and in front of benches.
en-US.dress.json.Placemaker.Dress.dressSports.Tooltip: Worn goalmouths and scuffs round courts and fitness stations.
en-US.dress.json.Placemaker.Dress.dressGround.Tooltip: Leaves, worn patches, mud and stones on open ground.
en-US.dress.json.Placemaker.Dress.dressShore.Tooltip: Wet sand, seaweed and shells along the waterline.
en-US.dress.json.Placemaker.Dress.dressWorks.Tooltip: Tyre tracks along drives, mud at gates, oil under machines, dust round heaps.
en-US.dress.json.Placemaker.Dress.dressRuins.Tooltip: Cracks, rubble grit, moss, glass and graffiti on old ground.
en-US.dress.json.Placemaker.Dress.dressGarden.Tooltip: Mulch under shrubs and beds, leaves under hedges.

en-US.fairground.json.Placemaker.Recipe.Fairground.Description: Event grounds: stalls along an avenue, food court, rides, a stage facing an open crowd field, toilets, light towers and temporary fencing.
en-US.fairground.json.Placemaker.Fairground.Name: Fairground
en-US.fairground.json.Placemaker.Fairground.style.Tooltip: What kind of event the site is laid out for. Changes the landmark, the stalls and the food vendors.
en-US.fairground.json.Placemaker.Fairground.layout.Tooltip: Avenue: a main avenue with side streets. Loop: a promenade round the arena. Grid: market aisles. Court: food trucks round a dining court.
en-US.fairground.json.Placemaker.Fairground.stalls.Tooltip: Stalls on a site of 0.6 ha. A bigger site gets more, in proportion (up to three times as many), so the streets stay lined.
en-US.fairground.json.Placemaker.Fairground.stage.Tooltip: A stage at one end facing an open crowd field that features keep clear of.
en-US.fairground.json.Placemaker.Fairground.field.Tooltip: Share of the site kept open in front of the stage.
en-US.fairground.json.Placemaker.Fairground.stallKind.Tooltip: Market stalls, marquee tents or food trucks along the streets.
en-US.fairground.json.Placemaker.Fairground.streetWidth.Toolti: Open width between the stall fronts on both sides of a street.
en-US.fairground.json.Placemaker.Fairground.sideStreets.Toolti: Streets crossing the main avenue, lined with stalls too.
en-US.fairground.json.Placemaker.Fairground.stallPitch.Tooltip: Distance between neighbouring stalls along a street.
en-US.fairground.json.Placemaker.Fairground.rides.Tooltip: Carousels, swing rides and other rides on paved pads beside the streets.
en-US.fairground.json.Placemaker.Fairground.landmark.Tooltip: One big eye-catcher: a big wheel at a funfair, a Christmas tree at a Christmas market, else a centrepiece.
en-US.fairground.json.Placemaker.Fairground.foodCourt.Tooltip: A paved court beside the avenue with table rows, food kiosks and string lights.
en-US.fairground.json.Placemaker.Fairground.stageEnd.Tooltip: Far end (from the main entrance), near end, or the side away from it.
en-US.fairground.json.Placemaker.Fairground.backstage.Tooltip: A fenced gravel service yard behind or beside the stage with containers and trailers.
en-US.fairground.json.Placemaker.Fairground.barrier.Tooltip: A barrier line in front of the stage.
en-US.fairground.json.Placemaker.Fairground.foh.Tooltip: Front-of-house tent in the crowd field, facing the stage.
en-US.fairground.json.Placemaker.Fairground.toilets.Tooltip: Portable toilet cabins in rows of up to eight beside the paths.
en-US.fairground.json.Placemaker.Fairground.lightSpacing.Toolt: Spacing of light towers along the streets (and at the field corners). 0 = none.
en-US.fairground.json.Placemaker.Fairground.festoons.Tooltip: Festoon poles between the stalls and round the food court.
en-US.fairground.json.Placemaker.Fairground.fence.Tooltip: Fencing round the whole site with gates at the entrances.
en-US.fairground.json.Placemaker.Fairground.worn.Tooltip: Paints trampled ground along the streets and over the crowd field (permanent terrain paint).
en-US.fairground.json.Placemaker.Fairground.paintLayer.Tooltip: Which of the map's four extra terrain textures to paint with.
en-US.fairground.json.Placemaker.Fairground.treeDensity.Toolti: Trees per hectare, planted as a shade belt along the outline.
en-US.fairground.json.Placemaker.Fairground.Issue.NoStage: No room for the stage — planned without one.
en-US.fairground.json.Placemaker.Fairground.Issue.SmallField: No room for a crowd field in front of the stage.
en-US.fairground.json.Placemaker.Fairground.Issue.NoBackstage: No room for the backstage yard.
en-US.fairground.json.Placemaker.Fairground.Issue.NoFoodCourt: No room for the food court.
en-US.fairground.json.Placemaker.Fairground.Issue.LoopFallback: The outline is too narrow for a loop — using an avenue.
en-US.fairground.json.Placemaker.AddOn.LightTowers.Name: Light towers
en-US.fairground.json.Placemaker.AddOn.LightTowers.where.Toolt: Beside the paths, along the edges, or in the open.
en-US.fairground.json.Placemaker.AddOn.FestivalCamping.Name: Festival camping
en-US.fairground.json.Placemaker.AddOn.FestivalCamping.toilets: A row of portable toilets by the camp lane.
en-US.fairground.json.Placemaker.Category.events.speaker: speakers

en-US.farmstead.json.Placemaker.Recipe.Farmstead.Description: A working farm: farmyard with barns and silos, fields by crop with rows, hedgerows, tracks, paddocks and a pond.
en-US.farmstead.json.Placemaker.Farmstead.Name: Farmstead
en-US.farmstead.json.Placemaker.Farmstead.subtype.Tooltip: What the farm mostly does. Presets set everything below to match; you can still change each option.
en-US.farmstead.json.Placemaker.Farmstead.yardAt.Tooltip: Where the farmyard with the barns and silos sits: by the road entrance, in the middle, or in a corner.
en-US.farmstead.json.Placemaker.Farmstead.yardSize.Tooltip: Share of the area the farmyard covers (it never gets smaller than about 22 m).
en-US.farmstead.json.Placemaker.Farmstead.tracks.Tooltip: Spine: one track along the farm through the yard. Grid: plus cross tracks every second field. None: only the driveway.
en-US.farmstead.json.Placemaker.Farmstead.fieldSize.Tooltip: Typical size of one field in hectares. Fields follow a grid aligned with the farm's long axis.
en-US.farmstead.json.Placemaker.Farmstead.arablePct.Tooltip: Share of the fields under crops (ploughed, in rows); the rest is pasture and hay meadow.
en-US.farmstead.json.Placemaker.Farmstead.rowAngle.Tooltip: Direction of the crop rows: along each field's long side, along or across the farm, or alternating field by field (patchwork).
en-US.farmstead.json.Placemaker.Farmstead.rowSpacing.Tooltip: Distance between the painted crop rows (vegetable plots use half of it).
en-US.farmstead.json.Placemaker.Farmstead.cropProps.Tooltip: Crop plants on arable fields: none (paint only), the outer rows of each field, or every row (many objects).
en-US.farmstead.json.Placemaker.Farmstead.hayMeadows.Tooltip: Some grass fields are mown hay meadows with bales lying in the swaths.
en-US.farmstead.json.Placemaker.Farmstead.fieldPaint.Tooltip: Paints ploughed soil and crop rows into the terrain texture. Permanent: removing the farm does not unpaint.
en-US.farmstead.json.Placemaker.Farmstead.paintLayer.Tooltip: Terrain layer (1–4) used for ploughed soil, the yard and worn ground. Which texture each is depends on the map.
en-US.farmstead.json.Placemaker.Farmstead.stripeLayer.Tooltip: Terrain layer (1–4) painted in stripes for the crop rows and mown swaths.
en-US.farmstead.json.Placemaker.Farmstead.windpump.Tooltip: A wind pump in a corner of the farmyard (when one is installed).
en-US.farmstead.json.Placemaker.Farmstead.levelYard.Tooltip: Flattens the farmyard, blended into the ground around it. Permanent terrain change.
en-US.farmstead.json.Placemaker.Farmstead.paddocks.Tooltip: Fenced livestock paddocks around the farmyard, each with a gate towards the yard, a trough and a field shelter.
en-US.farmstead.json.Placemaker.Farmstead.animals.Tooltip: Animal spawners in the paddocks and pastures. Horses and ranches also get a round pen.
en-US.farmstead.json.Placemaker.Farmstead.fieldHedges.Tooltip: Hedgerows between the fields, with a gateway in the middle of every field side.
en-US.farmstead.json.Placemaker.Farmstead.hedgeTrees.Tooltip: Trees standing in the hedgerows, per 100 m of hedge.
en-US.farmstead.json.Placemaker.Farmstead.pondSize.Tooltip: Diameter of the farm pond. The basin and its water are permanent.
en-US.farmstead.json.Placemaker.Farmstead.pondAt.Tooltip: Where the pond goes: the lowest ground (where water collects), next to the farmyard, or far from it.
en-US.farmstead.json.Placemaker.Farmstead.Issue.NoYard: Farmstead: no room for a farmyard; the farm is fields only.
en-US.farmstead.json.Placemaker.Farmstead.Issue.NoFields: Farmstead: no room left for fields. Make the area bigger or the fields smaller.
en-US.farmstead.json.Placemaker.Farmstead.Issue.NoPond: Farmstead: no room for the pond.
en-US.farmstead.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Apiary.Name: Beehives
en-US.farmstead.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Apiary.layout.Tooltip: Hives in neat rows, a loose cluster, or a ring.
en-US.farmstead.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Apiary.where.Tooltip: A quiet spot by the edge, the most open spot, or near the centre.
en-US.farmstead.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Apiary.flowers.Tooltip: A ring of flowerbeds around the hives.
en-US.farmstead.json.Placemaker.AddOn.FarmStand.Name: Farm stand
en-US.farmstead.json.Placemaker.AddOn.FarmStand.where.Tooltip: By the entrances, along the paths, or along the edges.
en-US.farmstead.json.Placemaker.AddOn.FarmStand.crates.Toolti: Crates of produce stacked on both sides of the stall.

en-US.features.json.Placemaker.Park.Feature.plaza.Tooltip: A paved square inside the park. Paths lead to its edge; trees keep clear of it.
en-US.features.json.Placemaker.Park.Feature.pond.Tooltip: A pond between the paths. Permanently lowers the terrain: removing the park leaves the basin.
en-US.features.json.Placemaker.Park.plazaAt.Tooltip: Where the plaza sits: in the middle, in a corner, against the longest side, or next to an entrance.
en-US.features.json.Placemaker.Park.plazaSize.Tooltip: Share of the park the plaza covers (12–90 m across). Made smaller when it does not fit.
en-US.features.json.Placemaker.Park.lakeSize.Tooltip: How much of the open space between the paths the pond may take.
en-US.features.json.Placemaker.Park.Issue.PlazaSmaller: The plaza was made smaller to fit the park.
en-US.features.json.Placemaker.Park.Issue.NoRoomForPlaza: There is no room for the plaza in this park.
en-US.features.json.Placemaker.Plaza.Feature.trees.Tooltip: Shade trees in a grid, or green islands with trees.
en-US.features.json.Placemaker.Plaza.Feature.fountain.Toolti: A large fountain with seating takes the centre of the square.
Restroom buildings you choose; replaces the automatic facilities.
en-US.features.json.Placemaker.Roads.Feature.edgeZoning.Tool: Zones the land along the new streets so buildings grow there.
en-US.features.json.Placemaker.Pond.Name: Pond
en-US.features.json.Placemaker.Pond.depth.Tooltip: How far the basin is dug below the water line.
en-US.features.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Kiosk.Name: Food stands
en-US.features.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Kiosk.benches.Tooltip: Two benches in front of each stand.
en-US.features.json.Placemaker.AddOn.PlazaTrees.Name: Plaza trees
en-US.features.json.Placemaker.AddOn.PlazaTrees.layout.Toolt: A regular grid of trees, or round green islands with a few trees each.
en-US.features.json.Placemaker.AddOn.PlazaTrees.spacing.Tool: Distance between trees (grid) or between islands.
en-US.features.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Restrooms.kiosk.Tooltip: Puts a kiosk next to each restroom.
en-US.features.json.Placemaker.Place.Issue.InvalidParent: The area is not a valid shape for a place inside it.
en-US.features.json.Placemaker.Place.Issue.NoRoom: The place does not fit inside the area.

en-US.fields.json.Placemaker.Feature.pitch.Tooltip: A real-size soccer, American football or rugby pitch (full, 9-, 7- or 5-a-side) on a levelled pad, with painted lines, goals, ball-stop fences, team benches, stands and floodlights. Made smaller to fit when needed.
en-US.fields.json.Placemaker.Feature.baseballDiamond.Toolt: A baseball or softball field with home plate in a corner: skinned infield, mound, foul lines, backstop, outfield fence, dugouts, bleachers and floodlights.
en-US.fields.json.Placemaker.Feature.runningTrack.Tooltip: A 400 m (or 300 m / 200 m) athletics oval with lanes, a turf infield holding a football pitch or field events, stands and floodlights.
en-US.fields.json.Placemaker.Feature.tennisCourts.Tooltip: One to four fenced tennis courts side by side with full markings, nets, benches and optional floodlights.
en-US.fields.json.Placemaker.Feature.basketballCourt.Toolt: A full 28 × 15 m basketball court with three-point lines, two hoops, bleachers, benches and floodlights.
en-US.fields.json.Placemaker.Feature.cricketGround.Tooltip: An oval cricket ground with a 22-yard pitch on a rolled strip, creases, boundary rope, sight screens and a pavilion.
en-US.fields.json.Placemaker.Feature.skateBowl.Tooltip: A concrete skate pad with a bowl dug into it (round or kidney-shaped) or a street plaza of ramps and rails.
en-US.fields.json.Placemaker.Park.pitchAt.Tooltip: Where the pitch goes: the middle, along the longest edge, beside an entrance or tucked into a corner. When the full size does not fit between the paths, a smaller pitch is used.
en-US.fields.json.Placemaker.Park.pitchPath.Tooltip: Adds a short path from the nearest path to the pitch.
en-US.fields.json.Placemaker.Park.baseballDiamondAt.Toolti: Where the diamond goes. In a corner, home plate tucks into the corner and the foul lines follow the edges. A smaller field is used when the full size does not fit.
en-US.fields.json.Placemaker.Park.baseballDiamondPath.Tool: Adds a short path from the nearest path to the backstop side of the diamond.
en-US.fields.json.Placemaker.Park.runningTrackAt.Tooltip: Where the track goes. A 400 m oval needs about 1.8 ha of open ground; a 300 m or 200 m track is used when it does not fit.
en-US.fields.json.Placemaker.Park.runningTrackPath.Tooltip: Adds a short path from the nearest path to the track.
en-US.fields.json.Placemaker.Park.tennisCourtsAt.Tooltip: Where the tennis courts go: the middle, along the longest edge, beside an entrance or tucked into a corner.
en-US.fields.json.Placemaker.Park.tennisCourtsPath.Tooltip: Adds a short path from the nearest path to the courts' gate.
en-US.fields.json.Placemaker.Park.basketballCourtAt.Toolti: Where the full basketball court goes: the middle, along the longest edge, beside an entrance or tucked into a corner.
en-US.fields.json.Placemaker.Park.basketballCourtPath.Tool: Adds a short path from the nearest path to the court.
en-US.fields.json.Placemaker.Park.cricketGroundAt.Tooltip: Where the cricket ground goes. A club ground needs about 1.4 ha of open ground; a village or school ground is used when it does not fit.
en-US.fields.json.Placemaker.Park.cricketGroundPath.Toolti: Adds a short path from the nearest path to the pavilion side of the ground.
en-US.fields.json.Placemaker.Park.skateBowlAt.Tooltip: Where the skate bowl goes: the middle, along the longest edge, beside an entrance or tucked into a corner.
en-US.fields.json.Placemaker.Park.skateBowlPath.Tooltip: Adds a short path from the nearest path to the skate bowl.
en-US.fields.json.Placemaker.Field.Issue.Smaller: The {0} was built at a smaller size so that it fits.
en-US.fields.json.Placemaker.Field.Issue.Orientation: The field could not be turned to the chosen direction here; it follows the space instead.
en-US.fields.json.Placemaker.Field.Tennis.Issue.Fewer: Only {0} of {1} tennis courts fit here.
en-US.fields.json.Placemaker.Field.Pitch.Name: Football pitch
en-US.fields.json.Placemaker.Field.Pitch.code.Tooltip: Soccer (penalty areas, centre circle), American football (yard lines, hash marks, end zones) or rugby (22 m, 10 m and 5 m lines, in-goal areas).
en-US.fields.json.Placemaker.Field.Pitch.format.Tooltip: Full size is 105 × 68 m. Smaller formats are the youth pitches: 73 × 46 m (9-a-side), 55 × 37 m (7-a-side), 37 × 27 m (5-a-side). Auto picks the biggest that fits.
en-US.fields.json.Placemaker.Field.Pitch.turf.Tooltip: A mown grass surface over the pitch and its run-off, so it reads as a pitch rather than park lawn.
en-US.fields.json.Placemaker.Field.Pitch.lines.Tooltip: Pitch markings painted as marking decals (only when marking decals are installed).
en-US.fields.json.Placemaker.Field.Pitch.lineSpacing.Toolt: Distance between the decals that make up a line. Smaller looks more solid but places more objects.
en-US.fields.json.Placemaker.Field.Pitch.stands.Tooltip: Bleachers along the touchline people arrive from, or along both touchlines.
en-US.fields.json.Placemaker.Field.Pitch.teamBenches.Toolt: Benches either side of halfway on the far touchline.
en-US.fields.json.Placemaker.Field.Pitch.floodlights.Toolt: Floodlight masts at the four corners, or at the corners and halfway.
en-US.fields.json.Placemaker.Field.Pitch.ballStops.Tooltip: Fences behind both goals so the ball does not roll into the park.
en-US.fields.json.Placemaker.Field.Pitch.rail.Tooltip: A low fence round the pitch with a gap towards the path.
en-US.fields.json.Placemaker.Field.Pitch.level.Tooltip: Levels the pitch and blends the ground back to the original height at the edge. Terrain changes are permanent.
en-US.fields.json.Placemaker.Field.Pitch.at.Tooltip: Where the pitch goes when it finds its own spot (in a park, the park's Position option is used).
en-US.fields.json.Placemaker.Field.Pitch.orientation.Toolt: Auto follows the space; north–south keeps the low sun out of the players' eyes.
en-US.fields.json.Placemaker.Field.Pitch.pathTo.Tooltip: Adds a short path from the nearest path to the pitch when it finds its own spot.
en-US.fields.json.Placemaker.Field.Baseball.Name: Baseball diamond
en-US.fields.json.Placemaker.Field.Baseball.format.Tooltip: Major (99 m fences, 90 ft bases), community (80 m), softball (67 m, 60 ft bases), Little League (61 m) or tee-ball (46 m). Auto picks the biggest that fits.
en-US.fields.json.Placemaker.Field.Baseball.infieldDirt.To: Dirt infield cut round the grass diamond, with the mound and the home-plate circle (all dirt for softball and tee-ball).
en-US.fields.json.Placemaker.Field.Baseball.warningTrack.T: A dirt band just inside the outfield fence (larger fields).
en-US.fields.json.Placemaker.Field.Baseball.lines.Tooltip: Foul lines, batter's boxes, on-deck circles, bases and plate as marking decals (when installed).
en-US.fields.json.Placemaker.Field.Baseball.lineSpacing.To: Distance between the decals that make up a line. Smaller looks more solid but places more objects.
en-US.fields.json.Placemaker.Field.Baseball.backstop.Toolt: A curved fence behind home plate.
en-US.fields.json.Placemaker.Field.Baseball.fence.Tooltip: Fences along both foul lines and the outfield arc; the gaps by the dugouts are the gates.
en-US.fields.json.Placemaker.Field.Baseball.dugouts.Toolti: A shelter (or team benches) beside each foul line between home and first / third base.
en-US.fields.json.Placemaker.Field.Baseball.stands.Tooltip: Bleachers along both foul lines past the dugouts.

en-US.fields.json.Placemaker.Field.Cricket.boundary.Toolti: A painted boundary rope, a low fence with a gate towards the path, or nothing.
en-US.fields.json.Placemaker.Field.Cricket.square.Tooltip: A mown grass square round the rolled pitch strip.
en-US.fields.json.Placemaker.Field.Cricket.lines.Tooltip: Creases, stumps and the boundary rope as marking decals (when installed).
en-US.fields.json.Placemaker.Field.Cricket.lineSpacing.Too: Distance between the decals that make up a line. Smaller looks more solid but places more objects.
Disc markers along the 30-yard circle (when the ground is big enough).
en-US.fields.json.Placemaker.Field.Cricket.sightScreens.To: Screens behind both ends in line with the pitch.

en-US.golf.json.Placemaker.Golf.Name: Golf
en-US.golf.json.Placemaker.Recipe.Golf.Description: Golf fitted to your area: real hole routing with tees, fairways, doglegs, greens, bunkers and water, or pitch & putt, mini golf, a driving range or disc golf.
en-US.golf.json.Placemaker.Golf.subtype.Tooltip: What kind of golf: a full course, short pitch & putt, mini golf lanes, a driving range or a disc golf course.
en-US.golf.json.Placemaker.Golf.holes.Tooltip: How many holes to route. Fewer are built when the area runs out of room (the summary says how many fit).
en-US.golf.json.Placemaker.Golf.holeLength.Tooltip: Average tee-to-green length. Holes vary around it (short par 3s, long par 5s) and shrink where space is tight. Each format keeps its own sensible range.
en-US.golf.json.Placemaker.Golf.doglegs.Tooltip: Share of holes that bend left or right on the way to the green.
en-US.golf.json.Placemaker.Golf.routing.Tooltip: Loop: the last holes come back to the clubhouse. Out and back: the front nine heads out, the back nine returns. Free: holes go wherever they fit best.
en-US.golf.json.Placemaker.Golf.bunkers.Tooltip: Sand bunkers per hole: greenside first, then fairway bunkers in the landing zone (outside of doglegs). Sunk into the ground.
en-US.golf.json.Placemaker.Golf.water.Tooltip: Ponds beside fairways and greens. They permanently lower the terrain and fill with water.
en-US.golf.json.Placemaker.Golf.fairwayWidth.Tooltip: Width of the fairway corridor; the mown fairway is a little narrower and tapers at both ends.
en-US.golf.json.Placemaker.Golf.teeBoxes.Tooltip: Tee boxes per hole, stepped back behind each other (forward, middle and back tees).
en-US.golf.json.Placemaker.Golf.shapeGreens.Tooltip: Lifts greens and tee boxes slightly above the ground (permanent terrain change).
en-US.golf.json.Placemaker.Golf.cartPaths.Tooltip: Wide paths beside every hole, linked from green to next tee. Off: footpaths from green to tee only.
en-US.golf.json.Placemaker.Golf.clubhouse.Tooltip: Clubhouse (or ticket kiosk / starter hut) by the main entrance, with parked golf carts.
en-US.golf.json.Placemaker.Golf.treeDensity.Tooltip: Trees in the rough between the holes. Parkland courses are wooded, links courses are open.
en-US.golf.json.Placemaker.Golf.roughPaint.Tooltip: Paints the rough with a terrain texture so the mown fairways stand out (permanent).
en-US.golf.json.Placemaker.Golf.roughLayer.Tooltip: Which of the map's extra terrain textures (1–4) the rough is painted with.
en-US.golf.json.Placemaker.Golf.miniTheme.Tooltip: Adventure: rocks and a pond. Garden: flowerbeds beside the lanes. Classic: a low fence, lamps and benches.
en-US.golf.json.Placemaker.Golf.bays.Tooltip: Bays along the covered tee line. Limited by the width of the area.
en-US.golf.json.Placemaker.Golf.Issue.FewerHoles: Only {0} of {1} holes fit in this area.
en-US.golf.json.Placemaker.Golf.Issue.NoHoles: No hole fits in this area: make it larger or choose a shorter format.
en-US.golf.json.Placemaker.Golf.Feature.practiceGreen.To: A putting green with several cups and a chipping bunker next to the clubhouse.
en-US.golf.json.Placemaker.AddOn.PuttingGreen.Name: Putting green
en-US.golf.json.Placemaker.AddOn.PuttingGreen.size.Toolt: Diameter of the green. It shrinks to fit when the space is small.
en-US.golf.json.Placemaker.AddOn.PuttingGreen.bunker.Too: A small sand bunker beside the green to practise chipping.

en-US.ground.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Ground.Name: Ground patches
en-US.ground.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Ground.dirt.Tooltip: Bare, trodden earth (terrain paint) with a few dirt marks.
en-US.ground.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Ground.mown.Tooltip: Tidy ovals of short grass with a clean edge.
en-US.ground.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Ground.meadow.Tooltip: Long grass with wildflowers, softly blended into the lawn.
en-US.ground.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Ground.rocky.Tooltip: Stony ground with a group of rocks: big stones in the middle, small ones around.
en-US.ground.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Ground.gravel.Tooltip: A gravel surface in a blended halo.
en-US.ground.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Ground.sand.Tooltip: A sand surface in a blended halo.
en-US.ground.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Ground.arrange.Tooltip: Scattered over open ground, a drift along the park's length, along the edges, or a cluster of touching patches.
en-US.ground.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Ground.finish.Tooltip: Automatic: each kind its natural look. Paint: terrain paint only. Surface: a surface inside every painted patch.
en-US.ground.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Ground.blend.Tooltip: Width of the soft border where a patch fades into the ground around it.
en-US.ground.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Ground.roughness.Toolti: How irregular the outlines are (0 % = smooth ovals).
en-US.ground.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Ground.pathTo.Tooltip: Join dirt, gravel, sand and mown patches to the nearest path.
en-US.ground.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Ground.wildflowers.Tool: Low bushes scattered through meadow patches.
en-US.ground.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Ground.dirtLayer.Toolti: Terrain texture layers 1–4 depend on the map; pick the one that looks right for each kind.

en-US.groundcover.json.Placemaker.GroundCover.Issue.Painted: No farmland surface is installed, so the fields are painted on the terrain instead (permanent).
en-US.groundcover.json.Placemaker.Common.Issue.ObjectBudget: This design wanted {0} objects; {2} repetitive props were thinned to stay near {1}. Fields and beds are drawn as ground surfaces instead.

en-US.harmony.json.Placemaker.Harmony.Issue.SteepPath: Some paths climb steeper than is comfortable: the ground is too steep to grade them without big cuts.
en-US.harmony.json.Placemaker.Harmony.Issue.Failed: Paths and pads could not be graded ({0}). They follow the ground as it is.

en-US.hikingTrail.json.Placemaker.HikingTrail.Name: Hiking trail
en-US.hikingTrail.json.Placemaker.Recipe.HikingTrail.Descriptio: A trail that follows the land: contour paths and switchbacks on slopes, a trailhead with parking and a map board, rest spots, viewpoints and footbridges over water.
en-US.hikingTrail.json.Placemaker.HikingTrail.landscape.Tooltip: Sets where the trail likes to run and what grows around it: forest, open meadow, along the ridge, down the canyon, or by the water.
en-US.hikingTrail.json.Placemaker.HikingTrail.route.Tooltip: Loop back to the trailhead, a through trail to another entrance (or out and back to the far end), or up to the summit and down another way.
en-US.hikingTrail.json.Placemaker.HikingTrail.maxGrade.Tooltip: Steepest climb the trail should take. Lower values follow the contours and add switchbacks on slopes.
en-US.hikingTrail.json.Placemaker.HikingTrail.wander.Tooltip: How much the trail meanders on easy ground.
en-US.hikingTrail.json.Placemaker.HikingTrail.restSpacing.Toolt: Distance between rest spots along the trail (bench facing the view, bin, picnic table). 0 = none.
en-US.hikingTrail.json.Placemaker.HikingTrail.viewpoints.Toolti: Viewing platforms with benches at the most prominent points along the trail.
en-US.hikingTrail.json.Placemaker.HikingTrail.lookoutTower.Tool: Puts a lookout tower (or shelter) at the best viewpoint.
en-US.hikingTrail.json.Placemaker.HikingTrail.picnicTables.Tool: A picnic table at every rest spot.
en-US.hikingTrail.json.Placemaker.HikingTrail.waymarkers.Toolti: Distance between signposts along the trail. 0 = none.
en-US.hikingTrail.json.Placemaker.HikingTrail.trailheads.Toolti: Car park, map board and bench at the main entrance, at every entrance, or none.
en-US.hikingTrail.json.Placemaker.HikingTrail.parking.Tooltip: Marked car spaces at each trailhead (a gravel or asphalt pad beside the trail entry).
en-US.hikingTrail.json.Placemaker.HikingTrail.mapBoard.Tooltip: A trail map or information board at the trailhead.
en-US.hikingTrail.json.Placemaker.HikingTrail.bridges.Tooltip: Lets the trail cross water on footbridges. Off: the trail goes around water.
en-US.hikingTrail.json.Placemaker.HikingTrail.treeDensity.Toolt: Trees per hectare (forest is 200 or more).
en-US.hikingTrail.json.Placemaker.HikingTrail.trailClear.Toolti: Distance kept free of trees on each side of the trail.
en-US.hikingTrail.json.Placemaker.HikingTrail.clearings.Tooltip: Open clearings beside the trail, each with a bench. Camp and picnic features get their own.
en-US.hikingTrail.json.Placemaker.HikingTrail.wornTrail.Tooltip: Paints worn ground along the trail (permanent).
en-US.hikingTrail.json.Placemaker.HikingTrail.shapeTerrain.Tool: Carves a gorge around the trail or raises a ridge under it, blended back to the ground at the outline (permanent). Auto: gorge for canyons, ridge for ridges.
en-US.hikingTrail.json.Placemaker.HikingTrail.terrainDepth.Tool: How deep the gorge is or how high the ridge rises, in metres.
en-US.hikingTrail.json.Placemaker.HikingTrail.bridgeAsset.Toolt: Path used for footbridges over water (automatic = a pedestrian bridge).
en-US.hikingTrail.json.Placemaker.HikingTrail.Issue.NoRoute: Hiking trail: no route fits inside the area (too narrow, blocked or under water).
en-US.hikingTrail.json.Placemaker.AddOn.TrailCamp.Name: Backcountry camp
en-US.hikingTrail.json.Placemaker.AddOn.TrailCamp.shelter.Toolt: A simple shelter at the edge of the camp.

en-US.industrialWorks.json.Placemaker.IndustrialWorks.Name: Industrial works
en-US.industrialWorks.json.Placemaker.Recipe.IndustrialWorks.Descri: Combined industrial sites: a plant, skips, bays, wrecks and containers, each in its own block of one planned works.
en-US.industrialWorks.json.Placemaker.IndustrialWorks.style.Tooltip: What the yard is for. Each type has its own layout, not just different props.
en-US.industrialWorks.json.Placemaker.IndustrialWorks.fill.Tooltip: How full the yard is. It fills from the main aisle outward, row by row, so a part-full yard still looks tidy.
en-US.industrialWorks.json.Placemaker.IndustrialWorks.aisle.Tooltip: Width of the drive aisles between the blocks: wide enough for trucks and forklifts.
en-US.industrialWorks.json.Placemaker.IndustrialWorks.office.Toolti: The office row and the gate booth by the way in.
en-US.industrialWorks.json.Placemaker.IndustrialWorks.parking.Toolt: A row of parked cars on the other side of the way in.
en-US.industrialWorks.json.Placemaker.IndustrialWorks.weighbridge.T: A concrete weighbridge across the way in, just inside the gate.
en-US.industrialWorks.json.Placemaker.IndustrialWorks.edge.Tooltip: What lines the inside of the fence: a screen of trees, a wall of concrete blocks, a two-high wall of containers, a wall of scrap cars piled two and three high (back and sides only), a bund of big boulders bedded into the ground (open at the gates), or plain ground.
en-US.industrialWorks.json.Placemaker.IndustrialWorks.fence.Tooltip: A security fence round the yard with a gap at the gate.
en-US.industrialWorks.json.Placemaker.IndustrialWorks.ground.Toolti: Concrete lays a slab over the yard. Gravel and dirt paint the ground itself: mud along the aisles, oily ground round the heaps and machines, dry grass along the fence. The aisles are always asphalt and whatever stands on the ground gets a concrete pad.
en-US.industrialWorks.json.Placemaker.IndustrialWorks.level.Tooltip: Levels the yard to one pad, blended back to the ground at the outline. Permanent.
en-US.industrialWorks.json.Placemaker.IndustrialWorks.paint.Tooltip: Paints the terrain: the yard ground, mud where the wheels go, oil-soaked ground round the heaps, worn dirt under the rows, dry grass at the fence. Permanent.
en-US.industrialWorks.json.Placemaker.IndustrialWorks.spoil.Tooltip: Mounds of dirt in the corners no block fits, painted, with a dead tree and dead bushes on them. Raises real terrain. Permanent.
en-US.industrialWorks.json.Placemaker.IndustrialWorks.banks.Tooltip: Long banks of earth along the back and side fence where there is room, spoil worked into their tops (rubble, boulders, now and then a heap of clay), stones and a dead bush at their foot. Raises real terrain. Permanent.
en-US.industrialWorks.json.Placemaker.IndustrialWorks.stones.Toolti: How many stones lie spilled round the heaps, the work pad and the banks, and along the dirt roads.
en-US.industrialWorks.json.Placemaker.IndustrialWorks.rubble.Toolti: Concrete, board and mixed rubble worked into the ground in drifting patches: only the tops show, like a yard that has been driven over for years. Never on the roads or a concrete yard; less in a yard laid out in blocks.
