en-US.landfill.json.Placemaker.Landfill.Name: Landfill
en-US.landfill.json.Placemaker.Recipe.Landfill.Description: A terraformed waste mound with a working face, gas wells and a haul road — or a capped hill, compost yard, recycling centre or fly-tip.
en-US.landfill.json.Placemaker.Landfill.style.Tooltip: Active tip, a finished capped hill, a compost yard, a recycling centre or an illegal dump.
en-US.landfill.json.Placemaker.Landfill.moundHeight.Tooltip: Height of the waste mound. Sides are kept near 1 in 3, so small sites get lower mounds. Permanent.
en-US.landfill.json.Placemaker.Landfill.moundSize.Tooltip: How much of the site the mound covers; the rest is the toe band with the haul road and lagoon.
en-US.landfill.json.Placemaker.Landfill.fill.Tooltip: How much waste lies about: on the face, in the bays, in the dumps.
en-US.landfill.json.Placemaker.Landfill.workingFace.Tooltip: The open flank where waste is tipped and compacted, cut into the side facing the gate.
en-US.landfill.json.Placemaker.Landfill.coverPiles.Tooltip: Soil piles beside the face for the daily cover.
en-US.landfill.json.Placemaker.Landfill.litterFences.Tooltip: Portable screens round the face that catch blowing litter.
en-US.landfill.json.Placemaker.Landfill.windrows.Tooltip: Long parallel compost rows on the pad.
en-US.landfill.json.Placemaker.Landfill.skips.Tooltip: Recycling yard: public drop-off skips along the drive-through loop.
en-US.landfill.json.Placemaker.Landfill.gasVents.Tooltip: Landfill-gas wells in a grid on the finished part of the mound.
en-US.landfill.json.Placemaker.Landfill.summitPath.Tooltip: A footpath that spirals up the mound to benches and a viewpoint at the top.
en-US.landfill.json.Placemaker.Landfill.meadow.Tooltip: Low bushes on the cap. No trees on the mound: roots would breach the cap.
en-US.landfill.json.Placemaker.Landfill.toeTrees.Tooltip: A ring of trees round the foot of the mound.
en-US.landfill.json.Placemaker.Landfill.leachatePond.Tooltip: A fenced, lined lagoon at the lowest free spot of the toe.
en-US.landfill.json.Placemaker.Landfill.fence.Tooltip: A sound fence, none, or a broken one with missing panels.
en-US.landfill.json.Placemaker.Landfill.screenTrees.Tooltip: A belt of trees just inside the fence.
en-US.landfill.json.Placemaker.Landfill.paint.Tooltip: Paints the terrain texture under the face, piles and dumps. Permanent.
en-US.landfill.json.Placemaker.Landfill.paintLayer.Tooltip: Which of the map's terrain textures (1–4) to paint with.
en-US.landfill.json.Placemaker.Landfill.grime.Tooltip: Dirt and puddle decals per 100 m², gathered round the waste and on the roads.
en-US.landfill.json.Placemaker.Landfill.Issue.MoundTooSmall: The site is too small or narrow for a mound; it was planned flat.
en-US.landfill.json.Placemaker.AddOn.SkipRow.Name: Skip row
en-US.landfill.json.Placemaker.AddOn.SkipRow.where.Tooltip: Along a straight stretch of the outline, or freestanding in the open.

en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Feature.shops.Tooltip: Kiosks, food stands and ice cream near the entrances and along the paths.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Feature.streetShops.Tooltip: Leaves empty plots along the street for zoned buildings; nothing else is placed on them.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Feature.streetShops.Issue.NoF: Zoning: no edge of the area faces a road.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Feature.streetShops.Issue.Too: Zoning: the area is too small to give up plots along the street.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Shops.shopAmount.Tooltip: How much of the street frontage is left for zoning.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Shops.shopLayout.Tooltip: One continuous row of plots, or plots with lawn between them.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Shops.shopLayout.band.Tooltip: A continuous row of plots along the street, with gaps at the entrances.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Shops.shopLayout.pads.Tooltip: Small plots spaced along the street, with lawn reaching the street between them.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Shops.shopDepth.Tooltip: How deep the plots reach from the street (whole 8 m zone cells).
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Feature.terrain.Tooltip: Reshapes the ground: mounds, hills, terraces, sunken or raised areas, berms. Blends back to the original ground at the edge. Permanent.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Terrain.Issue.Permanent: The terrain will be reshaped. This is permanent: removing the area later does not restore the ground.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Paint.Issue.Permanent: The ground texture will be painted. This is permanent: removing the area later does not undo it.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Terrain.Name: Terrain shape
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Terrain.shape.Tooltip: What to do with the ground. Every shape blends back to the original height at the edge.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Terrain.scale.Tooltip: Typical width of a mound or hill.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Terrain.maxSlope.Toolti: Steepest slope allowed between neighbouring spots.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Terrain.falloff.Tooltip: Distance over which the shape fades back to the original ground at the edge.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Terrain.Issue.NoRoads: Berms: no road next to the area, so they follow the whole edge.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Terrain.Issue.Nothing: The ground already has this shape: nothing to change.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Terrain.Issue.RoughGrou: The ground here is already bumpy: no extra mounds or hills were added.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Terrain.Issue.ScaledBac: The ground here is already uneven: the mounds or hills were made lower.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Decals.Name: Decals
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Decals.ground.Tooltip: Where decals may go: automatic follows the theme (cracks on paving, leaves on lawns and paths).
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Decals.Issue.NoGround: Decals: no suitable ground for this theme here.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Shops.Name: Food stands
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Shops.where.Tooltip: Near the entrances, spread along the paths, or along the edge.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Shops.seating.Tooltip: Cafe tables (or picnic tables, or benches) beside each stand.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Rocks.Name: Rocky outcrop
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Rocks.patch.Tooltip: Paints the terrain under each outcrop (permanent).
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Rocks.patchLayer.Toolti: Which of the map's four extra terrain textures to paint.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Restrooms.count.Tooltip: Exact number, or the most when placed by area.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Restrooms.byArea.Toolti: One restroom per so many hectares, the first near an entrance.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Park.pathStyle.Tooltip: Character of the paths: garden walk, curvy, formal axes, lakeside loop, scenic route, riverside meander, figure-eight, spoke and ring, woodland trail, boardwalk loop, promenade avenue or a perimeter circuit.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Park.naturalGround.Tooltip: Paints a few patches of natural ground into the lawns (permanent).
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Park.naturalLayer.Tooltip: Which of the map's four extra terrain textures to paint.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Park.playgroundPath.Tooltip: Adds a short path from the nearest path to the playground.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Park.picnicPath.Tooltip: Adds a short path from the nearest path to the picnic area.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Park.restroomsPath.Tooltip: Adds a short path from the nearest path to the restrooms.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Park.fountainPath.Tooltip: Adds a short path from the nearest path to the fountain.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Park.Issue.PathStyleFallback: This path style does not fit this area (or needs a pond or features); automatic paths were used instead.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Plaza.centerKind.Tooltip: Which kind of centrepiece the automatic choice uses.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Plaza.pattern.Tooltip: A second stone laid in bands: a grid, a line inside the border, or scattered large slabs.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Plaza.lighting.Tooltip: Feature lighting adds a ring of lamps round the centre and lamps along the edge.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Plaza.bollards.Tooltip: A row of bollards along the edges that face a road.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Plaza.levels.Tooltip: Terraces following the outline, a sunken or raised middle, or architectural levels on the square's axes: split level, a cascade of steps, a central podium or a sunken court (permanent terrain change).
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Plaza.levelHeight.Tooltip: Total rise or drop across all levels.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Plaza.amphitheatre.Tooltip: A stage at the longest edge with rows of benches on arcs facing it.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Plaza.amphiRaise.Tooltip: Each row a little higher than the one in front (permanent terrain change).
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Plaza.lawns.Tooltip: Share of the square covered by grass islands with a bush rim.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Plaza.beds.Tooltip: Clusters of flowerbeds near the edges.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Plaza.treeLayout.Tooltip: Trees round the edge, in a grid, or in groves.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Plaza.border.Tooltip: A strip of grass or gravel along the outline.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Plaza.pool.Tooltip: A long shallow pool along the main axis with benches beside it.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Plaza.realWater.Tooltip: Digs the pool and adds water, only on flat ground (permanent). Otherwise a water-look surface.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Plaza.jets.Tooltip: A splash pad of water jets, when such assets are installed.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Plaza.cafe.Tooltip: Groups of cafe tables near the edges.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Plaza.stalls.Tooltip: A grid of stalls facing the aisles.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Plaza.games.Tooltip: Chess or picnic tables in a corner.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Plaza.performance.Tooltip: A small stage with a few benches facing it.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Plaza.Issue.NoAmphitheatre: The amphitheatre does not fit here.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Plaza.Issue.NoPool: The reflecting pool does not fit here.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Plaza.Issue.PoolNotFlat: The ground is not flat enough for real water: the pool is a water-look surface.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Plaza.Issue.PoolPermanent: The pool digs into the terrain and adds water. This is permanent.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Plaza.Issue.NoRoadEdge: Bollards: no edge of the square faces a road.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Botanical.Name: Botanical garden
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Botanical.theme.Tooltip: Each lawn becomes one collection: flower beds, shrubs, an arboretum or meadow.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Botanical.showBeds.Tooltip: Round and long beds of massed flowers, edged with low shrubs, beside the walks.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Botanical.pathBorders.Tooltip: Share of the shrubs planted as borders along the walks; the rest stand in clumps on the lawns.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Botanical.bedDensity.Tooltip: Planting per hectare in the collections.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Botanical.glasshouse.Tooltip: A glasshouse (or shelter) beside the main path.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Sports.Name: Sports park
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.DogPark.Name: Dog park
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.DogPark.runs.Tooltip: One run, or separate runs for big and small dogs.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.DogPark.agility.Tooltip: Jumps, tunnels and weave poles in the big run.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.DogPark.doubleGates.Tooltip: A small fenced entry pen at each gate so dogs cannot slip out.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.DogPark.amenities.Tooltip: A dog bin by each gate and a drinking post.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Picnic.Name: Picnic grounds
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Picnic.grills.Tooltip: A grill or fire pit at each picnic spot.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Picnic.openLawn.Tooltip: Share of the area kept as an open lawn in the middle.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Picnic.facilities.Tooltip: One restroom per 1.5 ha beside the paths.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Reserve.Name: Nature reserve
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Reserve.treeDensity.Tooltip: Trees per hectare (forest is 200 or more).
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Reserve.clearings.Tooltip: Open meadows in the woods, each with a bench.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Reserve.lookout.Tooltip: A lookout tower (or shelter) beside the trail at the highest point.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Formal.Name: Formal garden
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Formal.allees.Tooltip: Rows of trees along the main axis.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Formal.Issue.NoParterres: No room for symmetric parterres in this outline.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Allotments.Name: Community garden
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Allotments.sheds.Tooltip: A shed on every plot, shared sheds, or none.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Allotments.hub.Tooltip: A shelter with tables and a water tank by the entrance.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Allotments.Issue.NoPlots: No plots fit: try smaller plots.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Market.Name: Market square
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Market.stalls.Tooltip: Stalls on a square of 0.4 ha. A bigger square gets more, in proportion (up to four times as many), so the market fills it.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Market.aisle.Tooltip: Width of the aisles between the stall rows.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Market.treeRing.Tooltip: Trees just inside the edge with benches between them.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Market.fill.Tooltip: The market fills the whole area, whatever its shape: a tree-lined market street between your entrances, a fountain where it meets the cross street, side streets, food courts at the crossings, planting islands and café groves in the blocks, and stalls right up to the edge.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Market.bollards.Tooltip: Bollards along the road edges (Big market: across each entrance, so people walk in and cars stay out).
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Market.access.Tooltip: Click the edge where you want a way in, as in the parking tool. Nothing is added for you: the market is built only once you have placed at least one entrance. The market street runs between your two main entrances.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Market.Marker.Access.Tip: A way in for people: the walk in, bollards across it, bike racks and a food cart beside it.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Market.Marker.Entrance.Tip: A small car park at this edge of the market, cars in and out here. People walk from it into the market.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Market.Marker.Entry.Tip: A car park entered here. Put a way out next to it; on its own it is made two-way.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Market.Marker.Exit.Tip: A car park left here. Put a way in next to it; on its own it is made two-way.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Market.Marker.Alley.Tip: A service lane for the stall vans: a small pedestrian street from a new junction on the street a short way into the market.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Market.Marker.AlleyIn.Tip: A service lane for the stall vans (pedestrian streets are two-way, so it is the same as a driveway).
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Market.Marker.AlleyOut.Tip: A service lane for the stall vans (pedestrian streets are two-way, so it is the same as a driveway).
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Market.Reason.NeedsEntrance: Place at least one entrance on the edge: a gate for people, a car entrance or a driveway. Nothing is built until you do.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Market.groundPaint.Tooltip: Bare soil in the tree pits, lawn in the planting islands and worn ground where the gates meet the street (terrain paint: it stays after the market is removed).
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Market.Issue.NoCarPark: A car entrance could not get a car park (no street in front of it, or no room there).
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Market.Issue.NoStreet: A driveway needs a street in front of it and room behind it; this one was left out.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Skate.Name: Skate park
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Skate.paved.Tooltip: How much of the area is the skate surface.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Cemetery.Name: Cemetery
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Cemetery.chapel.Tooltip: A memorial or chapel near the crossing of the main paths.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Greenway.Name: Greenway
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Greenway.restStops.Tooltip: Distance between rest stops (benches, bin, tree).
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Greenway.secondPath.Tooltip: A narrow parallel path where the strip is wide enough.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Recipe.BotanicalGarden.Descri: Winding paths through themed collections: flower beds, shrubs, arboretum, meadow, and a glasshouse.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Recipe.SportsPark.Description: A designed sports park: one main field with a spectator terrace and clubhouse, courts clustered by sport, a promenade loop, groves and berms between the zones.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Recipe.DogPark.Description: Fenced runs with double gates, an agility course, benches and dog bins.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Recipe.PicnicGrounds.Descript: Picnic spots with tables and grills round an open lawn, shelters and restrooms.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Recipe.NatureReserve.Descript: Dense woodland with narrow trails, clearings and a lookout.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Recipe.FormalGarden.Descripti: Symmetric parterres with hedges, axes, allées and a fountain.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Recipe.CommunityGarden.Descri: Allotment plots with crops and sheds along lanes, and a communal hub.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Recipe.MarketSquare.Descripti: A paved square with market stalls, a tree ring and a centrepiece.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Recipe.SkatePark.Description: A skate area with ramps, benches round it and graffiti.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Recipe.CemeteryGrounds.Descri: Grave sections in rows with hedges, straight paths and a memorial.
en-US.leisure.json.Placemaker.Recipe.GreenwayPark.Descripti: A linear park: a long walk with planting and rest stops.

en-US.logisticsYard.json.Placemaker.LogisticsYard.Name: Logistics yard
en-US.logisticsYard.json.Placemaker.Recipe.LogisticsYard.Descript: A storage and loading yard laid out like a parking lot: container stacks, pallets, crates or lumber in blocks between drive aisles, truck loading bays, sheds and floodlights.
en-US.logisticsYard.json.Placemaker.LogisticsYard.style.Tooltip: What fills the storage blocks. Mixed varies the goods from block to block.
en-US.logisticsYard.json.Placemaker.LogisticsYard.aisleWidth.Tool: Width of the drive aisles between the storage blocks (forklifts need 4 m, trucks 8 m or more).
en-US.logisticsYard.json.Placemaker.LogisticsYard.blockDepth.Tool: Depth of each storage block between two aisles. Deeper blocks hold more rows.
en-US.logisticsYard.json.Placemaker.LogisticsYard.blockLength.Too: Length of a storage block before the next cross aisle.
en-US.logisticsYard.json.Placemaker.LogisticsYard.fill.Tooltip: Share of the storage slots that hold goods. Lower looks like a yard mid-shift.
en-US.logisticsYard.json.Placemaker.LogisticsYard.angle.Tooltip: Rotates the aisle grid against the area's long axis.
en-US.logisticsYard.json.Placemaker.LogisticsYard.dockSide.Toolti: Where the truck loading bays go: the edge far from the entrance (back), near it (front), two edges, or none.
en-US.logisticsYard.json.Placemaker.LogisticsYard.trucks.Tooltip: Share of the loading bays with a truck or trailer backed in.
en-US.logisticsYard.json.Placemaker.LogisticsYard.sheds.Tooltip: Warehouse sheds or lean-tos along the edge behind the loading bays.
en-US.logisticsYard.json.Placemaker.LogisticsYard.machines.Toolti: Forklifts, reach stackers and yard tractors per hectare, working the aisles.
en-US.logisticsYard.json.Placemaker.LogisticsYard.gatehouse.Toolt: A guard booth and boom barrier at the main entrance.
en-US.logisticsYard.json.Placemaker.LogisticsYard.office.Tooltip: A site office cabin next to the entrance lane.
en-US.logisticsYard.json.Placemaker.LogisticsYard.markings.Toolti: Painted aisle lines, block outlines and bay lines (hard ground only).
en-US.logisticsYard.json.Placemaker.LogisticsYard.stains.Tooltip: Oil, dirt and puddle decals per 100 m², in clumps.
en-US.logisticsYard.json.Placemaker.LogisticsYard.level.Tooltip: Levels the yard so stacks stand flat, blended back to the ground at the outline (permanent).
en-US.logisticsYard.json.Placemaker.LogisticsYard.buffer.Tooltip: A planted strip of this width between the outline and the yard.
en-US.logisticsYard.json.Placemaker.LogisticsYard.Issue.NoBuffer: Logistics yard: the area is too narrow for the green buffer; the yard fills it all.
en-US.logisticsYard.json.Placemaker.AddOn.YardBreak.Name: Break area
en-US.logisticsYard.json.Placemaker.AddOn.YardBreak.cabin.Tooltip: A cabin or shed for the yard crew.

en-US.lookoutHill.json.Placemaker.LookoutHill.Name: Lookout hill
en-US.lookoutHill.json.Placemaker.Recipe.LookoutHill.Descriptio: A big landscaped hill blended into the ground, a spiral or switchback path to a summit viewpoint; or a sledding hill, viewpoint mound, observation terraces or kite hill.
en-US.lookoutHill.json.Placemaker.LookoutHill.subtype.Tooltip: Hilltop lookout, sledding hill (open run, straw bales), small viewpoint mound, stepped observation terraces or an open kite hill.
en-US.lookoutHill.json.Placemaker.LookoutHill.height.Tooltip: Height of the summit above the original ground. A small area cannot hold a tall hill at a walkable slope; the summary says when it came out lower.
en-US.lookoutHill.json.Placemaker.LookoutHill.shape.Tooltip: Mound: rounded foot and top. Cone: straight slopes. Dome: steep foot, round top. Mesa: broad flat top. Terraced: stepped levels.
en-US.lookoutHill.json.Placemaker.LookoutHill.summitAt.Tooltip: Centre: the middle of the area. Far: away from the entrance (long slope towards it). Highest: on the highest existing ground.
en-US.lookoutHill.json.Placemaker.LookoutHill.plateau.Tooltip: Radius of the flat top where the viewpoint plaza sits.
en-US.lookoutHill.json.Placemaker.LookoutHill.maxSlope.Tooltip: Steepest slope of the hill. Near the outline it always blends gently back to the original ground.
en-US.lookoutHill.json.Placemaker.LookoutHill.roughness.Tooltip: Natural bumps and hollows on the slopes.
en-US.lookoutHill.json.Placemaker.LookoutHill.pathStyle.Tooltip: Spiral: winds round the hill at an even grade. Switchback: zig-zags up one side. Direct: straight up where it is gentle. None: no path.
en-US.lookoutHill.json.Placemaker.LookoutHill.grade.Tooltip: How steeply the path climbs. 5 to 8 % is accessible, 12 % and more is a hiking trail.
en-US.lookoutHill.json.Placemaker.LookoutHill.restSpots.Tooltip: Benches spread along the way up.
en-US.lookoutHill.json.Placemaker.LookoutHill.viewpoint.Tooltip: What crowns the summit plaza: a lookout tower, a pavilion, a cairn or monument, just the plaza, or nothing.
en-US.lookoutHill.json.Placemaker.LookoutHill.telescopes.Toolti: Coin telescopes on the summit rim, looking out.
en-US.lookoutHill.json.Placemaker.LookoutHill.summitPaint.Toolt: Paints worn ground round the summit (permanent).
en-US.lookoutHill.json.Placemaker.LookoutHill.treeDensity.Toolt: Trees on the slopes below the tree line.
en-US.lookoutHill.json.Placemaker.LookoutHill.treeLine.Tooltip: Trees only grow below this share of the hill height, so the top stays open for the view.
en-US.lookoutHill.json.Placemaker.LookoutHill.runWidth.Tooltip: Width of the open sledding run down the longest slope. Kept free of trees and paths.
en-US.lookoutHill.json.Placemaker.LookoutHill.runOut.Tooltip: Straw bales (or a fence) across the bottom of the run.
en-US.lookoutHill.json.Placemaker.LookoutHill.kites.Tooltip: Kites and windsocks on the open upper slopes.
en-US.lookoutHill.json.Placemaker.LookoutHill.Issue.Lower: The hill reaches {0} m instead of {1} m: the area is too small for that height at this slope.
en-US.lookoutHill.json.Placemaker.LookoutHill.Issue.PathShort: The path could not reach the summit at this grade; try a steeper grade or the switchback style.
en-US.lookoutHill.json.Placemaker.LookoutHill.Issue.NoRun: No slope is long enough for a sledding run.
en-US.lookoutHill.json.Placemaker.LookoutHill.Feature.viewpoint: Benches with telescopes and information boards on the summit rim.
en-US.lookoutHill.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Viewpoint.Name: Viewpoint
en-US.lookoutHill.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Viewpoint.telescope.Too: A coin telescope beside each bench.
en-US.lookoutHill.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Viewpoint.board.Tooltip: A panorama / information board behind each bench.

en-US.memorialPark.json.Placemaker.Recipe.MemorialPark.Descripti: An axial procession to a focal monument, a reflecting pool, hedged garden rooms and quiet lighting.
en-US.memorialPark.json.Placemaker.Memorial.Name: Memorial park
en-US.memorialPark.json.Placemaker.Memorial.style.Tooltip: Sets the character: garden, paved square, war memorial, reflection garden or a sculpture park with a trail instead of an axis.
en-US.memorialPark.json.Placemaker.Memorial.focal.Tooltip: The monument closes the axis at the far end, or stands in the centre with the axis running on.
en-US.memorialPark.json.Placemaker.Memorial.processionWidth.Tool: Width of the processional way (8 m and more uses a wide path; the paved strip follows it when Paved procession is on).
en-US.memorialPark.json.Placemaker.Memorial.crossAxis.Tooltip: A second path crossing the main axis at the monument.
en-US.memorialPark.json.Placemaker.Memorial.paving.Tooltip: Lays a paved strip under the procession path and small pads under the trail sculptures. The walks themselves are always paths.
en-US.memorialPark.json.Placemaker.Memorial.forecourt.Tooltip: Radius (half-width for square courts) of the paved forecourt round the monument.
en-US.memorialPark.json.Placemaker.Memorial.raised.Tooltip: Raises the forecourt on a mound blended back to the ground (permanent terrain change).
en-US.memorialPark.json.Placemaker.Memorial.plaques.Tooltip: Plaques or wreaths in an arc before the monument (memorial stones when none are installed).
en-US.memorialPark.json.Placemaker.Memorial.sculptures.Tooltip: Sculptures on pads beside the trail (sculpture park).
en-US.memorialPark.json.Placemaker.Memorial.pool.Tooltip: A long pool on the axis; the walk splits round it.
en-US.memorialPark.json.Placemaker.Memorial.poolLength.Tooltip: Share of the procession the pool takes.
en-US.memorialPark.json.Placemaker.Memorial.realWater.Tooltip: Digs a shallow basin with real water (flat ground only, permanent). Otherwise a water-look surface.
en-US.memorialPark.json.Placemaker.Memorial.rooms.Tooltip: Quiet garden rooms enclosed by hedges, opening towards the axis.
en-US.memorialPark.json.Placemaker.Memorial.roomContent.Tooltip: What each room holds; Mixed alternates by memorial type.
en-US.memorialPark.json.Placemaker.Memorial.allees.Tooltip: Rows of trees either side of the procession, always in pairs.
en-US.memorialPark.json.Placemaker.Memorial.lawnTrees.Tooltip: Trees on the lawns, never in the view along the axis.
en-US.memorialPark.json.Placemaker.Memorial.bosque.Tooltip: The lawns either side of the axis planted as regular groves of trees, mirrored across the axis.
en-US.memorialPark.json.Placemaker.Memorial.borders.Tooltip: A ribbon of flowerbeds (poppies for a war memorial) either side of the procession.
en-US.memorialPark.json.Placemaker.Memorial.monumentScale.Toolti: How large the focal monument (or the trail's sculptures) stands, relative to the piece's own size.
en-US.memorialPark.json.Placemaker.Memorial.flowerRing.Tooltip: Flowerbeds round the forecourt (poppies for a war memorial).
en-US.memorialPark.json.Placemaker.Memorial.lighting.Tooltip: Solemn lighting: low bollard lights, lantern pairs, uplights on the monument and rooms only, or none.
en-US.memorialPark.json.Placemaker.Memorial.enclosure.Tooltip: A hedge or a fence round the park, with gaps at the entrances.
en-US.memorialPark.json.Placemaker.Memorial.Feature.flagCircle.T: A small round court with flagpoles on its rim and a plaque in the middle.
en-US.memorialPark.json.Placemaker.Memorial.Issue.NoAxis: The outline leaves no room for an axis; the memorial follows a trail instead.
en-US.memorialPark.json.Placemaker.Memorial.Issue.AxisBroken: Part of the procession would leave the area and was left out.
en-US.memorialPark.json.Placemaker.Memorial.Issue.NoPool: No room for the reflecting pool.
en-US.memorialPark.json.Placemaker.Memorial.Issue.PoolNotFlat: The ground under the pool is not flat (or raised); a water-look surface is used instead of real water.
en-US.memorialPark.json.Placemaker.Memorial.Issue.PoolPermanent: The pool basin is dug into the terrain permanently.
en-US.memorialPark.json.Placemaker.Memorial.Issue.FewerSculpture: Only {0} of {1} sculptures fit beside the trail.
en-US.memorialPark.json.Placemaker.AddOn.FlagCircle.Name: Flag circle

en-US.monuments.json.Placemaker.Feature.bigStatue.Tooltip: A statue scaled up to monumental size on a stepped plinth at the head of an axis, with an avenue of lamps, flags or trees leading to it.
en-US.monuments.json.Placemaker.Feature.folly.Tooltip: A Palace of Fine Arts style folly made of props: a rotunda of columns round a statue, a lagoon in front and colonnade walks you can stroll through.
en-US.monuments.json.Placemaker.Feature.obelisk.Tooltip: A tall obelisk on a stepped base in a paved court with corner pieces, benches and a low hedge ring.
en-US.monuments.json.Placemaker.Feature.triumphalArch.Tooltip: A gateway astride a wide walk: a triumphal arch, a pair of pylons or a screen of columns, with statues and flags.
en-US.monuments.json.Placemaker.Feature.sculptureWalk.Tooltip: A walk lined with sculptures on paved pads, each framed by shrubs with a bench facing it.
en-US.monuments.json.Placemaker.Feature.terraceGarden.Tooltip: A circle or oval of terraces with radial spokes and ring walks round a statue or fountain, with a small amphitheatre carved into one side.
en-US.monuments.json.Placemaker.Monuments.Issue.Smaller: The {0} was made smaller to fit the free space.
en-US.monuments.json.Placemaker.Monuments.Issue.ScaledDown: The {0} was scaled down to fit its space.
en-US.monuments.json.Placemaker.Monuments.Issue.NoColumns: No columns are installed: trees (or statues) stand in for them.
en-US.monuments.json.Placemaker.Monuments.Issue.NoArch: No arch is installed: a pair of pylons frames the walk instead.
en-US.monuments.json.Placemaker.Monuments.Issue.NoObelisk: No obelisk is installed: a monument or statue stands on the base instead.
en-US.monuments.json.Placemaker.Monuments.Issue.WaterNotFlat: The ground is not flat enough for real water: the pool uses a water-look surface.
en-US.monuments.json.Placemaker.Monuments.Issue.FewerSculptur: Only {0} of {1} sculptures fit along the walk.
en-US.monuments.json.Placemaker.Monuments.Issue.NoRoomForCent: There was no room for the centrepiece in the rotunda.
en-US.monuments.json.Placemaker.Monuments.Issue.AmphiNeedsSun: The amphitheatre needs sunken terraces (seats look down to the stage), so it was left out.
en-US.monuments.json.Placemaker.AddOn.BigStatue.Name: Big statue
en-US.monuments.json.Placemaker.AddOn.BigStatue.kind.Tooltip: A single figure, a group (the main figure with two lesser ones) or a colossus (larger still, on a taller base).
en-US.monuments.json.Placemaker.AddOn.BigStatue.size.Tooltip: How much bigger than the asset's normal size the statue is built. It is scaled down when the space is too small.
en-US.monuments.json.Placemaker.AddOn.BigStatue.plinth.Toolti: Raises the ground under the statue in square steps (permanent terrain change).
en-US.monuments.json.Placemaker.AddOn.BigStatue.focal.Tooltip: At the far end of the axis, or in the middle with the approach on one side.
en-US.monuments.json.Placemaker.AddOn.BigStatue.avenue.Toolti: What lines the approach, in matching pairs.
en-US.monuments.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Obelisk.Name: Obelisk
en-US.monuments.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Obelisk.size.Tooltip: How much bigger than the asset's normal size the obelisk is built.
en-US.monuments.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Obelisk.steps.Tooltip: Square steps raised in the ground under the obelisk (permanent terrain change). 0 = none.
en-US.monuments.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Obelisk.corners.Tooltip: Four matching pieces on the court's diagonals.
en-US.monuments.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Obelisk.hedgeRing.Toolt: A low hedge round the court with an opening on each axis.
en-US.monuments.json.Placemaker.AddOn.TriumphalArch.Name: Triumphal gateway
en-US.monuments.json.Placemaker.AddOn.TriumphalArch.kind.Tool: A triumphal arch astride the walk, a pair of pylons framing it, or a propylaea: a screen of columns with the walk through the middle.
en-US.monuments.json.Placemaker.AddOn.TriumphalArch.size.Tool: How much bigger than the asset's normal size the arch, pylons or columns are built.
en-US.monuments.json.Placemaker.AddOn.TriumphalArch.wings.Too: Four statues on the corners of the square, facing along the walk.
en-US.monuments.json.Placemaker.AddOn.TriumphalArch.square.To: Paving under and round the gateway.
en-US.monuments.json.Placemaker.AddOn.SculptureWalk.Name: Sculpture walk
en-US.monuments.json.Placemaker.AddOn.SculptureWalk.style.Too: A gentle S-curve, a straight gallery or a zigzag.
en-US.monuments.json.Placemaker.AddOn.SculptureWalk.size.Tool: How much bigger than the assets' normal size the sculptures are built.
en-US.monuments.json.Placemaker.AddOn.SculptureWalk.variety.T: Each sculpture a little bigger or smaller, so the walk has rhythm.
en-US.monuments.json.Placemaker.AddOn.SculptureWalk.backdrops: An arc of clipped shrubs behind each sculpture.
en-US.monuments.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Folly.Name: Folly (rotunda)
en-US.monuments.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Folly.columns.Tooltip: Columns in the rotunda's ring. Where the walk passes, the ring opens (with an arch when one is installed).
en-US.monuments.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Folly.columnScale.Toolt: How much bigger than the asset's normal size the columns (and arches) are built.
en-US.monuments.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Folly.arches.Tooltip: Arches where the walk enters and leaves the rotunda (only when arch assets are installed).
en-US.monuments.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Folly.arms.Tooltip: Columns on both sides of the walk curving round the lagoon from the rotunda: a colonnade you walk through.
en-US.monuments.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Folly.armSpan.Tooltip: How far round the lagoon each colonnade arm reaches from the rotunda.
en-US.monuments.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Folly.lagoon.Tooltip: An oval pool in front of the rotunda, so it is seen across the water.
en-US.monuments.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Folly.realWater.Tooltip: Digs the lagoon and fills it with water (permanent, flat ground only). Otherwise a water-look surface.
en-US.monuments.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Folly.planting.Tooltip: Shrubs at the ends of the lagoon and a backdrop of trees behind the rotunda.
en-US.monuments.json.Placemaker.AddOn.TerraceGarden.Name: Terrace garden
en-US.monuments.json.Placemaker.AddOn.TerraceGarden.direction: Stepping down to the centre (sunken), up to it (a garden mount) or flat. Terraces reshape the ground permanently.
en-US.monuments.json.Placemaker.AddOn.TerraceGarden.spokes.To: Radial walks from the inner ring to the outer ring; one points at the entrance and runs on to it.
en-US.monuments.json.Placemaker.AddOn.TerraceGarden.rings.Too: Oval walks on the innermost and outermost terraces, joined to every spoke.
en-US.monuments.json.Placemaker.AddOn.TerraceGarden.size.Tool: How much bigger than the asset's normal size the central statue is built (fountains up to 200 %).
en-US.monuments.json.Placemaker.AddOn.TerraceGarden.amphithea: Carves the side opposite the entrance into rows of seats looking down at a small stage in front of the centrepiece (sunken terraces only).

en-US.orchardPark.json.Placemaker.Recipe.OrchardPark.Descriptio: An orchard open as a park: fruit trees in rows with mown aisles, blossom meadow, picnics under the trees, beehives and a cider stand.
en-US.orchardPark.json.Placemaker.OrchardPark.Name: Orchard park
en-US.orchardPark.json.Placemaker.OrchardPark.style.Tooltip: Which fruit the orchard grows. Presets set the layout to match; automatic trees prefer that fruit when it is installed.
en-US.orchardPark.json.Placemaker.OrchardPark.grid.Tooltip: Square grid, quincunx (every other row offset, like dice fives), tight rows with wide alleys, or blocks of one variety each.
en-US.orchardPark.json.Placemaker.OrchardPark.spacing.Tooltip: Distance between the trees (rows: trees closer in the row, alleys wider).
en-US.orchardPark.json.Placemaker.OrchardPark.rowAngle.Tooltip: Rows along the area's long side, across it, or diagonally.
en-US.orchardPark.json.Placemaker.OrchardPark.paths.Tooltip: A cross through the middle, a grid of blocks, a loop inside the edge, or a blossom avenue lined with trees.
en-US.orchardPark.json.Placemaker.OrchardPark.blockSize.Tooltip: Distance between the grid paths, and the size of the variety blocks.
en-US.orchardPark.json.Placemaker.OrchardPark.gaps.Tooltip: Share of planting spots left empty, as in a real old orchard.
en-US.orchardPark.json.Placemaker.OrchardPark.windbreak.Tooltip: A row of tall trees along the edge sheltering the orchard.
en-US.orchardPark.json.Placemaker.OrchardPark.meadow.Tooltip: Share of the orchard floor left as long meadow (painted patches with wildflowers).
en-US.orchardPark.json.Placemaker.OrchardPark.flowers.Tooltip: Flower clumps per hectare, mostly in the meadow patches.
en-US.orchardPark.json.Placemaker.OrchardPark.mownAisles.Toolti: Mown strips painted between the tree rows. Permanent terrain texture.
en-US.orchardPark.json.Placemaker.OrchardPark.lawn.Tooltip: Covers the whole orchard with a mown grass surface (cherry blossom lawns).
en-US.orchardPark.json.Placemaker.OrchardPark.meadowLayer.Toolt: Terrain layer (1–4) for the meadow patches. Which texture each is depends on the map.
en-US.orchardPark.json.Placemaker.OrchardPark.aisleLayer.Toolti: Terrain layer (1–4) for the mown aisles.
en-US.orchardPark.json.Placemaker.OrchardPark.picnicSpots.Toolt: Picnic tables in the shade between the trees, beside the paths.
en-US.orchardPark.json.Placemaker.OrchardPark.benchEvery.Toolti: A bench along the paths every this many metres (0 = none).
en-US.orchardPark.json.Placemaker.OrchardPark.harvestProps.Tool: Fruit crates and ladders under a few trees.
en-US.orchardPark.json.Placemaker.OrchardPark.glade.Tooltip: An open lawn in the middle with a veteran tree and benches round it; features like a fountain go there.
en-US.orchardPark.json.Placemaker.OrchardPark.Issue.NoGlade: Orchard park: no room for the central glade.
en-US.orchardPark.json.Placemaker.OrchardPark.Issue.NoTrees: Orchard park: no room for fruit trees. Make the spacing smaller or the area bigger.

en-US.palettes.json.Placemaker.Palette.Tooltip: The stones the ground is laid in, chosen together: main paving, border band, focal pad, walks and inlay accents. Automatic uses the palette this style is designed with. Pick a surface for one role below to make your own mix.
en-US.palettes.json.Placemaker.Palette.auto.Detail: The palette this style is designed with: calm stone unless the preset says otherwise.
en-US.palettes.json.Placemaker.Palette.classic.Detail: Pale granite slabs · slate border · grey fan-set rondel · herringbone walks
en-US.palettes.json.Placemaker.Palette.sandstone.Detail: Smooth sandstone · warm grey paver border · pale flagstone rondel
en-US.palettes.json.Placemaker.Palette.brickStone.Detail: Muted brick herringbone · granite sett border · grey fan-set rondel
en-US.palettes.json.Placemaker.Palette.modern.Detail: Large concrete slabs · black granite band · polished concrete pad
en-US.palettes.json.Placemaker.Palette.terracotta.Detail: Ochre slabs · orange brick bands · pale stone rondel
en-US.palettes.json.Placemaker.Palette.cobble.Detail: Granite setts · slate flag border · cobble-fan rondel · flagstone walks
en-US.palettes.json.Placemaker.Palette.garden.Detail: Soft grey-brown brick · warm sett border · pale flagstone pads
en-US.palettes.json.Placemaker.Palette.custom.Detail: Your own surfaces: the roles you picked below replace the palette's stones, the rest stay Automatic.
en-US.palettes.json.Placemaker.Palette.Role.borderSurface.To: The band that frames the paving along the outline (and the ring round the focal pad). Automatic = from the palette.
en-US.palettes.json.Placemaker.Palette.Role.focalSurface.Too: The round pad under and around the fountain or statue. Automatic = from the palette.
en-US.palettes.json.Placemaker.Palette.Role.pathSurface.Tool: Walks laid from the entrances to the middle on bigger squares. Automatic = from the palette.
en-US.palettes.json.Placemaker.Palette.Role.inlaySurface.Too: Thin dark accents: inlay lines, tree pits, an outer ring. Automatic = from the palette.

en-US.park.json.Placemaker.Recipe.Park.Description: Paths, lawns, trees and benches, with entrances where the area meets streets.
en-US.park.json.Placemaker.Recipe.ParkWithPlayground.Des: A park with a playground on its largest lawn and a restroom by the paths.
en-US.park.json.Placemaker.Recipe.Campground.Description: Pitches along a loop of paths in the woods, with restrooms and a picnic area.
en-US.park.json.Placemaker.Park.Name: Park
en-US.park.json.Placemaker.Park.pathWidth.Tooltip: Narrow footpaths everywhere, wide main paths with narrow side paths, or wide paths everywhere.
en-US.park.json.Placemaker.Park.treeDensity.Tooltip: Trees per hectare of planted ground. Around 25 feels like an open city park, 80 or more like a wood.
en-US.park.json.Placemaker.Park.furniture.Tooltip: Benches per 100 m of path. Lamps and bins follow the same density.
en-US.park.json.Placemaker.Park.paths.Tooltip: How many paths to lay out. Automatic adds loops as the park gets bigger.
en-US.park.json.Placemaker.Park.entrances.Tooltip: Click the outline to place entrances. Without any, entrances are suggested where the park meets streets.
en-US.park.json.Placemaker.Park.belt.Tooltip: Trees and bushes along the boundary, with open gaps so the park stays visible from the street.
en-US.park.json.Placemaker.Park.animals.Tooltip: Lets forest animals appear in the larger groves.
en-US.park.json.Placemaker.Park.lake.Tooltip: Digs a lake into the largest open lawn. The terrain change is permanent: removing the park does not fill it back in.
en-US.park.json.Placemaker.Park.Issue.LakePermanent: The lake permanently lowers the terrain. Removing the park leaves the basin.
en-US.park.json.Placemaker.Park.Issue.NoRoomForLake: There is not enough open space between the paths for a lake.
en-US.park.json.Placemaker.Park.style.Tooltip: The park idiom: how trees and bushes are composed (groves, belts, lined walks, a strict grid…). Pick a preset to also get the matching path figure.
en-US.park.json.Placemaker.Park.picnicSpots.Tooltip: Extra open lawn kept free of planting for picnic groups (with the Picnic feature on).
en-US.park.json.Placemaker.Park.Issue.NoRoomForAmenity: There is no free room for the {0} in this park.
en-US.park.json.Placemaker.Park.Issue.AmenityMoved: The {0} did not fit at the chosen position and was placed elsewhere.
en-US.park.json.Placemaker.Campground.Name: Campground
en-US.park.json.Placemaker.Campground.pitchSize.Tooltip: Side length of each pitch. Tents need about 8 m, caravans 12 m or more.
en-US.park.json.Placemaker.Campground.facilities.Tooltip: Restrooms beside the paths, one for every 25 pitches.
en-US.park.json.Placemaker.Campground.Issue.NoPitches: No pitch fits along the paths. Try a smaller pitch size or a larger area.
en-US.park.json.Placemaker.Common.Issue.NoAssets: No {0} are installed, so none were placed.
en-US.park.json.Placemaker.Common.Issue.InvalidArea: The area outline is not valid (it crosses itself or is too thin).
en-US.park.json.Placemaker.Common.Issue.AreaTooSmall: The area is too small ({0} m², needs at least {1} m²).
en-US.park.json.Placemaker.Common.Issue.AreaTooLarge: The area is too large ({0} m², at most {1} m²).
en-US.park.json.Placemaker.Common.Issue.SurfaceDropped: Part of the ground surface has a shape the game cannot draw and was left out.
en-US.park.json.Placemaker.Common.Issue.NoSpace: There is no free space left for {0}.

en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Name: Parking lot
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Control.StallAngle.Ti: How the spaces sit against the driving lane. Angled spaces are easier to drive into but fit fewer cars.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.StallAngle.90.Tip: Spaces at right angles to the lane. Fits the most cars.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.StallAngle.60.Tip: Slanted spaces, a little easier to drive into.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.StallAngle.45.Tip: Strongly slanted spaces. Easiest to drive into, fits the fewest cars.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Control.Entrances.Tip: Where cars and people get in and out. We put entrances on the nearest street for you; pick a type, click the outline next to a street to add one, right-click one to remove it.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Marker.Entrance.Tip: Cars come in and go out here. Joins the street without changing it.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Marker.Entry.Tip: Cars can only drive in here. Needs a way out somewhere else.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Marker.Exit.Tip: Cars can only drive out here. Needs a way in somewhere else.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Marker.Alley.Tip: Cars come in and go out through a real junction: the kerb opens and the street gets a crossing. Uses a few building plots on the street.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Marker.AlleyIn.Tip: A junction where cars can only drive in. Needs a way out somewhere else.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Marker.AlleyOut.Tip: A junction where cars can only drive out. Needs a way in somewhere else.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Marker.Footpath.Tip: A path for people only, from the lot to the sidewalk. Does not count as a car entrance.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Marker.BusStop.Tip: A bus stop on the street in front of the lot.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Marker.ZoningPatch.Ti: Keeps a strip by the street free for buildings at this spot. Width and depth are set under Buildings.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Control.EdgeZoning.Ti: Leaves a strip next to the street for buildings to grow on. The lot shrinks to make room.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.EdgeZoning.None.Tip: The parking lot uses the whole area.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.EdgeZoning.OneSide.Ti: Buildings along the side with the longest street frontage.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.EdgeZoning.All.Tip: Buildings along every side that faces a street.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Control.ZoneType.Tip: What may be built there: homes, shops, offices… Automatic uses the city's usual zone.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Control.ZoningDepth.T: How many plots deep the buildings reach, counted from the street (one plot is 8 m, the game allows up to 6).
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Control.ZoningPatchWi: How many plots wide each building plot marker is (one plot is 8 m).
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Control.AsphaltSurfac: The surface laid under the lanes and spaces.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Control.Greenery.Tip: Where grass, trees and bushes go instead of pavement.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Greenery.None.Tip: Paved from edge to edge. No trees.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Greenery.Edges.Tip: Planting along the outline and at the ends of rows. Rows sit back to back.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Greenery.Medians.Tip: Also a planted strip between back-to-back rows. Costs some spaces.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Control.AisleWidth.Ti: Wider lanes give cars more room to turn in.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Control.Setback.Tip: A planted strip between the outline and the first spaces. Tidier, costs spaces.
Which way the rows of spaces run.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.RowAngleMode.Edge.Tip: Rows run parallel to the longest straight side of the outline.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.RowAngleMode.Across.T: Rows run at right angles to the longest side.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Control.RowAngle.Tip: Sets the row angle for the whole lot.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Control.Grading.Tip: On sloped ground every row of spaces is levelled into a terrace (at most 2 % fall), with gentle ramps (at most 8 %) between the terraces. Off: the lot follows the ground as it is.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Issue.SteepGrade: The ground is steep here: levelling the lot moves up to {0} m of earth at its edges.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Control.PerimeterRoad: A driving lane along the whole outline with a row of spaces on the outside. Off uses the full area for rows.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Control.CrossEvery.Ti: Spaces between short lanes that join neighbouring rows. 0 = none.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Control.EntranceStyle: How an entrance joins the street outside.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.EntranceStyle.Connect: An invisible lane that joins the street without changing it.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.EntranceStyle.Alley.T: Builds a small alley into the street. The street gets a real junction and its kerb opens up; it costs a few zoning cells there.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Control.RowEndPlantin: Ends each row with a patch of grass. Off packs in more cars.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Control.MedianDepth.T: Width of the planted strip between back-to-back rows.
The surface laid where there is no pavement.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Control.Trees.Tip: Tree types to plant. Empty = a mix of street trees.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Control.Bushes.Tip: Bush types to plant. Empty = a mix of bushes.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Control.PlantingDensi: How much of the green is planted.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Control.Lanterns.Tip: Places street lights along the rows; lit at night.
Which street light to use. Automatic picks single and double lights.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Control.LanternSpacin: Largest gap between two lights along a row.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Control.EvShare.Tip: Share of spaces with a charger. Chargers stand in the planting behind a pair of spaces, close to the entrance.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Control.AccessibleSha: Share of wide spaces for disabled drivers, placed closest to the entrance.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Control.Fee.Tip: What a car pays to park here.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Reason.NeedsEntrance: Place at least one entrance for cars: a two-way entrance or driveway, or one way in and one way out. Footpaths are for people only.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Reason.EntryWithoutEx: An entry without an exit - cars could not leave.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Reason.ExitWithoutEnt: An exit without an entry - place an entry.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Issue.BadShape: This outline crosses itself. Move a corner so the edges don't cross.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Issue.TooSmall: Too small for a parking lot ({0} m², needs at least {1} m²).
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Issue.TooNarrow: Too narrow for parking rows once the edge margin is taken off. Make the area wider, or the edge margin smaller.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Issue.TooLarge: Too large for one parking lot ({0} m², at most {1} m²). Split it into smaller areas.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Issue.NoEntrance: No entrance for cars yet. Pick an entrance type and click the outline next to a street.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Issue.EntrancesSugges: Entrances were placed on the nearest road. Move them along the outline if you like.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Issue.EntranceNoPath: Entrance {0} has no straight path to a driving lane. Move the entrance.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Issue.EntranceNoRoad: Entrance {0} has no street outside it. Cars can only use it if a street is built there.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Issue.EntrancesTooClo: Two entrances are on top of each other - one was left out.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Issue.UnreachableStal: {0} spaces could not be reached from an entrance and were left out.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Issue.PerimeterRoadDr: Too narrow for a lane around the lot - built without it.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Issue.SurfaceGaps: {0} m² of pavement or grass is missing: the game cannot display this shape there.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Issue.LayoutFailed: The parking lot could not be planned: {0}
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Issue.NoStalls: No parking space fits here. Try a wider area, narrower spaces or no lane around the lot.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Issue.ReservedSpace: {0} spaces were left out because something else is already planned there.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Issue.NoRoomForCharge: No room for chargers: they need planting behind the spaces.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Issue.NoRoomForAccess: No room for accessible spaces: they need a row of straight (90°) spaces.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Issue.LotOwnerRejecte: The game cannot use this outline as one lot. Smooth out very sharp corners.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Issue.TooManyEntrance: At most {0} entrances per lot - {1} were left out.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Issue.BusStopNoRoad: Bus stop {0} has no street in front of it. Move it next to a street.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Issue.ZoningNoStreet: No side of this lot faces a street, so no buildings can grow along it.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Issue.ZoningPatchNoSt: This building plot is not next to a street. Move it to a side that faces one.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Issue.ZoningStreetToo: The street is too far away for buildings this deep. Increase the building depth or draw the lot closer to the street.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Issue.ZoningLeavesNoR: The building strips would leave no room for parking - built without them.
en-US.parking.json.Placemaker.Parking.Issue.ZoningTrimmed: {0} building strips were left out because parking runs through them.

en-US.parkpaths.json.Placemaker.Park.bikePath.Tooltip: A wide cycle route through the park between two far-apart entrances, kept apart from the footpaths and crossing them square. Uses a bike path when one is installed, otherwise a wide path.
en-US.parkpaths.json.Placemaker.Park.bikeGap.Tooltip: How far the bike route keeps from footpaths running alongside it.
en-US.parkpaths.json.Placemaker.Park.bikeAsset.Tooltip: Automatic picks the two-way bike path, then a path with bike lanes, then a wide footpath.
en-US.parkpaths.json.Placemaker.Park.smallPaths.Tooltip: Narrow paths across the larger lawns, joining two main paths.
en-US.parkpaths.json.Placemaker.Park.trails.Tooltip: Informal trails winding through the planted belt along the park's edge, joined to the nearest path.
en-US.parkpaths.json.Placemaker.Park.trailAsset.Tooltip: Automatic picks a gravel or dirt path when one is installed, otherwise a footpath.
en-US.parkpaths.json.Placemaker.Park.desireLines.Tooltip: Desire lines: shortcuts people take where the paths make them walk around. Worn = trodden ground (terrain paint), paved = small paths.
en-US.parkpaths.json.Placemaker.Park.desireLayer.Tooltip: Ground texture for the worn shortcuts: 1 dry grass, 2 forest floor, 3 dirt, 4 sand on vanilla maps (other maps: the closest material).
en-US.parkpaths.json.Placemaker.Park.trailStyle.Tooltip: Path net: a real dirt/gravel path. Painted: trodden dirt painted into the ground (frayed, natural); people can walk it only when an invisible pedestrian path is available, otherwise it is just a look. Painting is permanent.
en-US.parkpaths.json.Placemaker.Paint.Issue.TrailVisualOnly: Painted trails are a look only: no invisible pedestrian path in this playset, so nobody walks them.
en-US.parkpaths.json.Placemaker.Park.Issue.BikeNeedsTwoEntran: The bike route needs two bike entrances at least 40 m apart.
en-US.parkpaths.json.Placemaker.Park.Issue.NoBikeRoute: No room for a bike route through the park.
en-US.parkpaths.json.Placemaker.Park.Issue.FewerSmallPaths: Fewer small paths fit than asked for.
en-US.parkpaths.json.Placemaker.Park.Issue.NoRoomForTrails: No room for dirt trails along the edge.
en-US.parkpaths.json.Placemaker.Park.Issue.NoDesireLines: The paths are already direct: no shortcuts needed.
en-US.parkpaths.json.Placemaker.Feature.ground.Tooltip: Patches of dirt, mown grass, meadow, rocks, gravel or sand with soft, blended edges.
en-US.parkpaths.json.Placemaker.Park.Issue.NoBikeEntrances: The bike route is on, but there are no bike entrances. Place two bike entrances on the outline.
en-US.parkpaths.json.Placemaker.Entrance.Pedestrian.Tip: People walk in here. A thin path joins the park paths.
en-US.parkpaths.json.Placemaker.Entrance.Bike.Tip: Cyclists and pedestrians come in here. The bike route runs between bike entrances. Best facing a bike path or a road with bike lanes.
en-US.parkpaths.json.Placemaker.Entrance.Main.Tip: The grand entrance: a wide main walk and a gateway of planters and lamps. Best on a big road.
en-US.parkpaths.json.Placemaker.Entrance.Service.Tip: Maintenance access: a short service track to the paths. Best on a quiet street.
en-US.parkpaths.json.Placemaker.Entrance.Reason.Needs: Place at least one entrance on the outline. The faint markers show good spots.

en-US.parkstats.json.Placemaker.Settings.ApplyParkStats.Desc: Parks and plazas you build add their attractiveness to the city's tourism, like vanilla parks. Turning it off removes it from existing builds on the next load.
en-US.parkstats.json.Placemaker.Settings.RealParkStats.Desc: Each park gets a small hidden park building at its road edge, so leisure, wellbeing coverage and upkeep work like a vanilla park. Off: only attractiveness counts. Turning it off removes the companions on the next load.
en-US.parkstats.json.Placemaker.ParkStats.NoRoadEdge: No road edge: only attractiveness applies.
en-US.parkstats.json.Placemaker.ParkStats.F.Size: Size {0} m² gives a base of {1} (1.9 × (area ÷ 1,000 m²)^0.85, fitted to vanilla parks).
en-US.parkstats.json.Placemaker.ParkStats.F.Quality: Quality ×{0} = 0.55 + trees {1} + water {2} + landmarks {3} + amenities {4} + play and sport {5} + seating {6}.
en-US.parkstats.json.Placemaker.ParkStats.F.Band: Vanilla parks of a similar size, scaled to this size: {0} to {1}.
en-US.parkstats.json.Placemaker.ParkStats.F.AttrGame: In game it is multiplied by the terrain bonus (forest, shore, height: up to +40 %) when built. The city adds every park's attractiveness² ÷ 10,000 into its tourism.
en-US.parkstats.json.Placemaker.ParkStats.F.LeisureGame: Vanilla parks: each visit raises a citizen's leisure by about this ÷ 5 per update until they are satisfied.
en-US.parkstats.json.Placemaker.ParkStats.F.CoverageGame: Vanilla parks: coverage fades with walking distance as 1 − (distance ÷ range)², times the entertainment strength.
en-US.parkstats.json.Placemaker.ParkStats.F.CapacityGame: Vanilla parks: each covered street uses up capacity by its length and density; when it runs out, coverage fades.
en-US.parkstats.json.Placemaker.ParkStats.F.EntertainmentGame: Vanilla parks: residents get up to 20 wellbeing from park coverage (20 × √(coverage ÷ 1.5), at most 20).
en-US.parkstats.json.Placemaker.ParkStats.F.UpkeepGame: What a vanilla park this good costs to run (about a fifth of its price per month).

en-US.plaza.json.Placemaker.Recipe.Plaza.Description: A walkable paved square with a centerpiece and seating.
en-US.plaza.json.Placemaker.Plaza.Name: Plaza
en-US.plaza.json.Placemaker.Plaza.furniture.Tooltip: How many times the furniture arrangement is placed. Around the centre they come in facing pairs.
en-US.plaza.json.Placemaker.Plaza.centerSize.Tooltip: Space kept free around the centerpiece (radius). Raise it for a bigger fountain.
en-US.plaza.json.Placemaker.Plaza.arrangement.Tooltip: Up to five items placed side by side, for example bench – lamp – bench.
en-US.plaza.json.Placemaker.Plaza.walkable.Tooltip: Lets pedestrians cross the whole plaza freely instead of only along paths.
en-US.plaza.json.Placemaker.Plaza.access.Tooltip: Click the outline where people enter. Without any, access points are suggested along adjacent streets.
en-US.plaza.json.Placemaker.Plaza.Issue.CenterpieceDoesNo: The centerpiece does not fit this plaza and was left out.
en-US.plaza.json.Placemaker.Plaza.Issue.NoRoomForAmenity: There is no free room for the {0} on this square.
en-US.plaza.json.Placemaker.Plaza.Issue.AmenityMoved: The {0} did not fit at the chosen position and was placed elsewhere.
en-US.plaza.json.Placemaker.Plaza.Issue.TooSmallForLevels: The square is too small for these levels (needs about 24 × 16 m).
en-US.plaza.json.Placemaker.Plaza.paveStyle.Tooltip: The stones the square is laid in: field, framing bands, light accents and dark inlays. Automatic follows the square's character.
en-US.plaza.json.Placemaker.Plaza.Issue.NoLawn: No room for lawns between the axes; make the square bigger or lower the lawn share.

en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.Name: Look
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.sideReach.Tooltip: How far a garden reaches sideways to meet the neighbour beside it. Very large values make outgrow slower in big cities.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.maxFrontGap.Tooltip: Two neighbours this far apart at the street still join (one shared fence or hedge).
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.maxBackGap.Tooltip: How far apart their back corners may be (wedges on the outside of a curve).
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.maxRearGap.Tooltip: Two gardens back to back this far apart meet in the middle.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.maxFacingGap.Tooltip: A side facing another house's side or back this far away meets it halfway.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.maxDeepen.Tooltip: A shallow garden reaches back to its row's deepest by up to this much.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.hug.Tooltip: A side or back nobody else has grows out to a road, path or building near it and hugs it.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.hugReach.Tooltip: How far a garden reaches out to a road, path or building.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.openReach.Tooltip: A side or back with nothing near it still grows this far into open land. Very large values fill whole fields.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.maxSlope.Tooltip: A garden stops growing where the land gets steeper than this, so it never climbs a cliff. 80 %: only real cliffs and walls stop it. 0: no limit.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.maxRise.Tooltip: A garden stops growing where the land is more than this above or below its house (m). 0: no limit (the default).
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.deckClearance.Tooltip: A garden grows under an elevated road or a bridge only where its road is at least this high above the ground (m). Lower, it is a crack and nothing grows there. Trees never grow under one.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.wrap.Tooltip: Two deep gardens meet behind a shallow one between them.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.closeBacks.Tooltip: A garden open at the back closes with a fence or hedge the joining freed.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.closeGardens.Tooltip: Every open edge of a garden (not its street front) gets fence or hedge pieces, following its bends and the roads it hugs.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.fenceKind.Tooltip: What closes the open edges: the house's own fence or hedge kind, or one for every house.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.lawns.Tooltip: A garden's lawn grows to its new fences, around driveways and paving.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.lawnReach.Tooltip: Mowed lawn this far from the house; a big garden is painted further out. 400 or more: lawn everywhere.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.paintedGardens.Tooltip: How many gardens are painted instead of keeping their lawns. Natural and Yard more often, Tidy seldom.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.gardenPaint.Tooltip: How strong the paint of a painted garden is.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.paint.Tooltip: Soft ground past the gardens and worn ground along fences facing open land.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.blendWidth.Tooltip: How far the paint reaches past the gardens.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.blendFar.Tooltip: How far the fainter, wider band reaches.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.blendStrength.Tooltip: How strong the paint past the gardens is.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.gardenLayer.Tooltip: The ground a painted garden is painted with.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.meadowLayer.Tooltip: The ground of a big garden beyond its lawn near the house.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.blendLayer.Tooltip: The ground of the band just past the gardens.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.blendFarLayer.Tooltip: The ground of the wider, fainter band further out.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.edgeLayer.Tooltip: Worn ground along back fences that face open land.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.edgeWidth.Tooltip: How wide the worn band along those fences is.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.roadLayer.Tooltip: A band along the roads and paths beside the gardens.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.roadWidth.Tooltip: How wide the band along roads and paths is.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.rockLayer.Tooltip: The ground under rock gardens and outcrops.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.rockGround.Tooltip: The wider ground around an outcrop.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.yardLayer.Tooltip: The ground of a storage yard.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.patchLayer.Tooltip: The ground of the worn patches in big gardens.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.patchChance.Tooltip: How many worn patches big gardens get.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.plant.Tooltip: Planted beds with bushes along new fences. Off: no planting, features, paths or rocks.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.bedChance.Tooltip: How often a new fence gets a bed with bushes.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.bushesPerGarden.Toolti: The most bushes the beds of one garden get.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.features.Tooltip: Big new garden land gets something by its look: a rock garden, a sand pit, a log pile, a bench nook, a flower garden, a storage yard.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.featureChance.Tooltip: How many big gardens get a feature.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.featureSpacing.Tooltip: A big garden gets one more feature for every this much new land (at most 6).
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.featureMinLand.Tooltip: New garden land a feature needs.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.rockChance.Tooltip: How often a rock sits where two gardens meet at the street (never against a hedge).
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.pathChance.Tooltip: How many big gardens get a paved path from the house to the back.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.alleys.Tooltip: A narrow even gap between two houses becomes a paved walkway.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.alleyChance.Tooltip: How often a narrow gap becomes a walkway.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.pavedFill.Tooltip: Shops, offices and works fill the land between them with the surface most of their ground already is, not lawn.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.zoneArea.Tooltip: On: the empty zone cells of the area get the zones below, as lots that start at the road. Off: only the buildings already there are edited (each zone type by its own Outgrow settings).
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.zoneA.Tooltip: The main zone of the area.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.zoneB.Tooltip: A second zone mixed in (its share below).
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.zoneC.Tooltip: A third zone mixed in (its share below).
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.zoneAssetA.Tooltip: Any zone of the game (mods' zones too) instead of the zone type above.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.zoneAssetB.Tooltip: Any zone of the game instead of the second zone type.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.zoneAssetC.Tooltip: Any zone of the game instead of the third zone type.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.shareA.Tooltip: How much of the land the main zone gets (%); what the zones leave stays empty.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.shareB.Tooltip: How much of the land the second zone gets (%). 0: none.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.shareC.Tooltip: How much of the land the third zone gets (%). 0: none.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.zonePattern.Tooltip: How the lots of the zones follow each other along the roads: at random, in clumps of lots alike, or spread evenly.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.zoneGrain.Tooltip: About how many lots in a row get the same zone.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.levelLots.Tooltip: On sloped land every lot becomes level at the height it meets its road, with banks blending into the land around (painted). A lot that would need more earth than the limit is made shallower, or left empty. Lots already level are left alone.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.levelEarth.Tooltip: The deepest cut or highest fill a lot may need (m). Lots on steeper land are made shallower or left empty.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.levelBank.Tooltip: No bank around the levelled lots is steeper than this (50 % = 1 in 2).
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.levelWalls.Tooltip: Where a lot's back meets ground 2.6 m or more above it (the lot behind it, or the hill), a concrete wall stands there with a walk along its top, instead of a bank that takes the lots' ground. The lot behind gives up the row under the walk.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.roadRule.Tooltip: The blocks along roads at least this wide get their own zone (shops along the big roads…).
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.roadZone.Tooltip: The zone the cells along the big roads get.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.roadMinWidth.Tooltip: How wide a road must be for the road rule.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.roadDepth.Tooltip: How deep the lots along those roads are, in zone cells.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.widthMinA.Tooltip: The narrowest lot of the main zone along the road, in zone cells (8 m).
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.widthMaxA.Tooltip: The widest lot of the main zone along the road, in zone cells.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.depthMinA.Tooltip: The shallowest lot of the main zone back from the road, in zone cells.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.depthMaxA.Tooltip: The deepest lot of the main zone back from the road, in zone cells (6 at most).
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.widthMinB.Tooltip: The narrowest lot of the second zone along the road, in zone cells (8 m).
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.widthMaxB.Tooltip: The widest lot of the second zone along the road, in zone cells.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.depthMinB.Tooltip: The shallowest lot of the second zone back from the road, in zone cells.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.depthMaxB.Tooltip: The deepest lot of the second zone back from the road, in zone cells (6 at most).
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.widthMinC.Tooltip: The narrowest lot of the third zone along the road, in zone cells (8 m).
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.widthMaxC.Tooltip: The widest lot of the third zone along the road, in zone cells.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.depthMinC.Tooltip: The shallowest lot of the third zone back from the road, in zone cells.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.depthMaxC.Tooltip: The deepest lot of the third zone back from the road, in zone cells (6 at most).
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.shapeLots.Tooltip: The lots in the area grow past their borders over the land around them, by the look: shared fences and hedges, lawns, ground, beds, paths (the settings below). They never grow into roads, buildings, other lots, your builds or water. With Zoning on, the houses that grow there later outgrow too. Off: the area is only zoned.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.Nothing: Switch on Zoning or Outgrow: there is nothing to build.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Zoning.Type.suburb.Tooltip: Detached houses with gardens that outgrow their lots. Styles: corner shops, leafy, tight.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Zoning.Type.village.Tooltip: Houses spread out with fields between them, in clumps. Styles: hamlet, village green, country lanes.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Zoning.Type.townhouses.Toolti: Rows of town houses on narrow lots. Styles: terraces, mews, corner shops.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Zoning.Type.mainStreet.Toolti: Shops along the street, homes between them; the big roads get the big shops. Styles: high street, boulevard, market town.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Zoning.Type.townCentre.Toolti: Flats over shops, homes and a few offices: the middle of a town. Styles: old town, new town, square.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Zoning.Type.downtown.Tooltip: Towers: flats, offices and big shops. Styles: business district, city living, shopping.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Zoning.Type.businessPark.Tool: Offices in green grounds. Styles: campus, office strip, tech park.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Zoning.Type.industrial.Toolti: Works and yards. Styles: mixed yards, trade park, big works.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Zoning.Type.seaside.Tooltip: Houses by the water and a few shops. Styles: beach houses, promenade, resort.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.zoneFill.Tooltip: How much of the empty land gets zoned: the rest of the lots along the roads stay empty (mixed in the same way as the zones).
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.roadMinA.Tooltip: The narrowest road this zone goes on (m; a two-lane road is 16 m).
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.roadMaxA.Tooltip: The widest road this zone goes on (m; 48: any).
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.roadMinB.Tooltip: The narrowest road this zone goes on (m; a two-lane road is 16 m).
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.roadMaxB.Tooltip: The widest road this zone goes on (m; 48: any).
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.roadMinC.Tooltip: The narrowest road this zone goes on (m; a two-lane road is 16 m).
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.roadMaxC.Tooltip: The widest road this zone goes on (m; 48: any).
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.zoneOutgrow.Tooltip: Each zone type's own Outgrow switch and settings (set in the panel).
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.fill.Tooltip: What a building's land past its own lot becomes, whatever the building is: a garden (lawn, fences, beds), a car park yard (green edges, bins, marked bays with parked cars), or paving. The outgrow type alone decides: whatever the building is (a house given a car park type gets a car park).
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.parkStyle.Tooltip: How a car park yard looks. Clean: a wide grass edge, trees in planters at the ends of the rows, a tidy bin corner. Everyday: grass edges, bins and stock, most bays taken. Industrial: concrete, no grass, more vans, pallets, barrels, skips and containers, dry worn ground further out.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.parkReach.Tooltip: How far out from the building its car park yard is paved and parked. Further out, the land is the outgrow type's own: its ground, patches, rocks and things.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.parkCars.Tooltip: The share of parking bays with a car or van in them.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.parkWorn.Tooltip: The chance a car park's edge is worn, as the strip malls' are: the ground painted, dirt fading into dry grass out from the paving, no grass strip. Otherwise a grass strip with trees. Industrial car parks are always worn.
en-US.polish.json.Placemaker.Polish.waterGap.Tooltip: How far the land keeps from water: gardens, yards and car parks stop this far from the shore, along a smooth line. The building's own lot is never cut.

en-US.quarry.json.Placemaker.Recipe.Quarry.Description: A terraced pit with a haul road spiralling down the benches, stockpiles and plant — or a big flooded dig lake. Permanent terrain change.
en-US.quarry.json.Placemaker.Quarry.Name: Quarry
en-US.quarry.json.Placemaker.Quarry.subtype.Tooltip: Working pit, wet lake dig, or an old flooded / abandoned quarry.
en-US.quarry.json.Placemaker.Quarry.pitSize.Tooltip: How much of the space inside the rim the pit takes.
en-US.quarry.json.Placemaker.Quarry.pitShape.Tooltip: Follow the outline, an oval, or a rough organic face.
en-US.quarry.json.Placemaker.Quarry.levels.Tooltip: Number of steps down to the floor (fewer when the pit is too narrow).
en-US.quarry.json.Placemaker.Quarry.benchHeight.Tooltip: Drop of each step. Total depth = benches × bench height.
en-US.quarry.json.Placemaker.Quarry.benchWidth.Tooltip: Width of each ledge (the haul road runs on them).
en-US.quarry.json.Placemaker.Quarry.rimWidth.Tooltip: Untouched ground between the outline and the pit, where the yard sits.
en-US.quarry.json.Placemaker.Quarry.maxSlope.Tooltip: Steepest change allowed measured from the outline, so the pit always meets the original ground.
en-US.quarry.json.Placemaker.Quarry.water.Tooltip: Fills the pit with water. A permanent lake.
en-US.quarry.json.Placemaker.Quarry.waterFill.Tooltip: How far up the pit the water stands; always below the lowest dry bench so it never spills.
en-US.quarry.json.Placemaker.Quarry.warnings.Tooltip: A fence round the pit edge and danger signs.
en-US.quarry.json.Placemaker.Quarry.haulRoad.Tooltip: A ramp road from the gate spiralling down the benches to the floor.
en-US.quarry.json.Placemaker.Quarry.grade.Tooltip: Steepness of the ramp between benches.
en-US.quarry.json.Placemaker.Quarry.plant.Tooltip: Crusher and screens by the pit, a site office by the gate (and conveyors on a lake dig).
en-US.quarry.json.Placemaker.Quarry.lookout.Tooltip: A viewpoint with benches on the rim, with a footpath to the outline.
en-US.quarry.json.Placemaker.Quarry.pitPaint.Tooltip: Paints the exposed rock / sand texture over the pit and roads. Permanent.
en-US.quarry.json.Placemaker.Quarry.paintLayer.Tooltip: Which of the map's four extra terrain textures to paint.
en-US.quarry.json.Placemaker.Quarry.scree.Tooltip: Fallen rocks per hectare at the foot of the bench walls.
en-US.quarry.json.Placemaker.Quarry.overgrowth.Tooltip: Trees and bushes taking over the rim (and the benches of old quarries).
en-US.quarry.json.Placemaker.Quarry.Issue.LakePermanent: The flooded pit is a permanent lake: removing the quarry keeps the basin and the water.
en-US.quarry.json.Placemaker.Quarry.Issue.NoRoomForPit: The area is too narrow for a pit inside the rim; only the yard is built.
en-US.quarry.json.Placemaker.Quarry.Issue.FewerBenches: Only {0} of {1} benches fit in this pit.
en-US.quarry.json.Placemaker.Quarry.Issue.NoWater: The pit is too shallow to hold water; it stays dry.

en-US.restArea.json.Placemaker.Recipe.RestArea.Description: A roadside stop: car park, amenity court with restrooms and vending, picnic grove, dog walk and viewpoint.
en-US.restArea.json.Placemaker.RestArea.Name: Rest area
