en-US.restArea.json.Placemaker.RestArea.style.Tooltip: What kind of stop this is. Each type adds its own signature: fuel island, charging lounge, viewpoint…
en-US.restArea.json.Placemaker.RestArea.lotShare.Tooltip: Share of the area used for the car park at the main entrance. 0 = no car park.
en-US.restArea.json.Placemaker.RestArea.groups.Tooltip: Picnic table groups along the footpath.
en-US.restArea.json.Placemaker.RestArea.lotGreen.Tooltip: Planting in the car park: none, along its edges, or in medians between rows.
en-US.restArea.json.Placemaker.RestArea.truckBays.Tooltip: Long, wide stalls and wider aisles for trucks and coaches.
en-US.restArea.json.Placemaker.RestArea.evShare.Tooltip: Share of the stalls with a charger.
en-US.restArea.json.Placemaker.RestArea.hubSize.Tooltip: Width of the paved amenity court where people step out of the car.
en-US.restArea.json.Placemaker.RestArea.vending.Tooltip: Vending machines along the back of the court.
en-US.restArea.json.Placemaker.RestArea.fuelPumps.Tooltip: A fuel island on the car park side of the court (decorative props).
en-US.restArea.json.Placemaker.RestArea.signs.Tooltip: A map / information board at the walk-in point.
en-US.restArea.json.Placemaker.RestArea.grills.Tooltip: A grill or fire pit at each picnic spot.
en-US.restArea.json.Placemaker.RestArea.dogRun.Tooltip: A small fenced dog run off a branch path, with a bin and a bench.
en-US.restArea.json.Placemaker.RestArea.viewpoint.Tooltip: A lookout with a bench arc at the far end of the path.
en-US.restArea.json.Placemaker.RestArea.moundHeight.Tooltip: Raise the viewpoint on a mound blended into the ground (permanent terrain change).
en-US.restArea.json.Placemaker.RestArea.screen.Tooltip: A belt of trees along the outline that screens the stop from the road.
en-US.restArea.json.Placemaker.Transport.Issue.NoLot: No room for a car park here; the stop is planned without one.

en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Name: Roads
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.pattern.Tooltip: How the streets are laid out inside the area.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Option.pattern.grid.Too: Straight streets in a regular grid, aligned with the longest side of the area.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Option.pattern.tree.Too: A collector along the area with branches ending in pairs of cul-de-sacs.
Winding streets with cul-de-sacs and a few loops, like a suburban subdivision.
Streets follow the terrain's contour lines, linked by gentle uphill roads. Needs sloped terrain.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Option.pattern.mixed.To: A radial centre with a roundabout, surrounded by organic streets.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Option.pattern.loop.Too: Widely spaced collectors with a looping local street inside each large block.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Option.pattern.superblo: Collectors around groups of 3 × 3 blocks with car-free streets inside.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Option.pattern.concentr: Rings that follow the shape of the area, joined by connecting streets.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Option.pattern.radial.T: A central roundabout with straight avenues out to the edge, optionally crossed by circular rings.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.roadMix.Tooltip: Which road goes where, in one pick. It sets the street, avenue, local, roundabout and perimeter roads and their upgrades below; changing any of them makes it Custom.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Option.roadMix.auto.Too: The standard mix: Two-Lane Roads for streets, Four-Lane Roads for avenues, a Two-Lane One-Way Road around roundabouts.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Option.roadMix.quiet.To: Two-Lane Roads everywhere, even the avenues, with street trees and grass verges. Calm streets for houses.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Option.roadMix.alleys.T: Narrow two-way Alleys between the blocks; Two-Lane Roads for the avenues and the edge.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Option.roadMix.pedestri: Pedestrian Streets inside (service vehicles only); cars stay on the Two-Lane avenues and the perimeter road.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Option.roadMix.boulevar: Tree-lined Two-Lane streets and divided Four-Lane avenues with trees in the median.
Streets: Two-Lane + trees · Avenues: Four-Lane Divided + median trees
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Option.roadMix.downtown: A busy core: Four-Lane streets, Six-Lane avenues and three-lane one-way roundabout rings.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Option.roadMix.bike.Too: The standard mix with bike lanes on every street and avenue.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Option.roadMix.bike.Det: Streets: Two-Lane + bike lanes · Avenues: Four-Lane + bike lanes
Gravel Roads for villages and farmland; a Two-Lane Road for the through routes and the edge.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Option.roadMix.custom.T: Your own picks: choose each road below.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.streetAsset.Too: The road for ordinary streets (and the perimeter road unless it has its own pick). Automatic places a Two-Lane Road.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.localAsset.Tool: The road for cul-de-sacs and short local streets. Automatic uses the street road (a Two-Lane Road by default).
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.localAsset.Desc: Dead ends and small side streets.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.avenueAsset.Too: The road for avenues and collectors, the main lines through the layout. Automatic places a Four-Lane Road.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.avenueAsset.Des: Wider main roads through the grid.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.roundaboutAsset: The one-way road that circles a roundabout island. Automatic places a Two-Lane One-Way Road: two lanes in the ring direction, like the Four-Lane avenue that feeds it. Only used when the layout has roundabouts (Radial, Mixed, Grid avenue crossings).
The one-way ring of a roundabout.
The loop around the edge of a drawn or painted area. Automatic uses the street road.
The road around the edge of the area.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.pathAsset.Toolt: Path used for the walkways and for the car-free streets inside superblocks. Automatic places a Pavement Path (dirt trails take a trail path when your playset has one).
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.angle.Tooltip: Rotates the layout relative to the longest side of the area.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.alignTerrain.To: Turns the layout so one set of streets follows the slope's contour lines.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.gridMode.Toolti: Size blocks by distance, or by a number of columns and rows that fill the area.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Option.gridMode.count.T: A fixed number of columns and rows spread evenly over the area.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.gridColumns.Too: Number of streets across the area's length.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.gridRows.Toolti: Number of streets across the area's width.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.culDeSacs.Toolt: Turns some grid streets into dead ends with a turning circle.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.culDeSacFrequen: Share of blocks that get a cul-de-sac.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.culDeSacDepth.T: How far a cul-de-sac reaches into its block.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.culDeSacStagger: Alternates the side cul-de-sacs start from, block after block.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.capStyle.Toolti: Decoration placed at the end of every cul-de-sac.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Option.capStyle.grass.T: Turning circle with a grass island.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Option.capStyle.trees.T: Turning circle with trees in the middle.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.capSize.Tooltip: Size of the turning circle. Automatic matches the road width.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Option.capSize.xl.Toolt: Extra large turning circle (not available in asphalt).
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.avenueColumn.To: Makes one column of the grid an avenue.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.avenueRow.Toolt: Makes one row of the grid an avenue.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.avenueIndex.Too: Which column or row becomes the avenue, counted from the first street.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.roundaboutIslan: Places a roundabout island where the avenue column and row meet.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.treeBranchSpaci: Distance between two branches on the same side of the collector.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.treeCulDeSacSpa: Distance between two pairs of cul-de-sacs along a branch.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.loops.Tooltip: Share of branches that join another street instead of ending in a cul-de-sac.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.variation.Toolt: Another random layout with the same settings.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.contourLinkSpac: Distance between roads that climb from one level street to the next.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.avenues.Tooltip: Number of straight avenues leaving the central roundabout.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.loopCollectorSp: Distance between collectors; each large block between them gets its own loop.
Size of each block inside a superblock.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.rings.Tooltip: Number of rings. Fewer are built when the area is too narrow for them.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.concentricConne: Number of streets linking the innermost ring outwards.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.roundaboutRadiu: Radius of the central roundabout (reduced to fit the area).
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.perimeterRoad.T: A road around the edge of the area that the new streets connect to.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Option.perimeterRoad.au: On for drawn and painted areas; off for picked blocks, which are already surrounded by roads.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.perimeterCorner: Radius of the perimeter road at the corners of a drawn or painted area. Small keeps the road on your outline (never tighter than the road can turn); the winding styles use more.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.connectExisting: Joins new streets to the roads they meet or cross.
Leaves out streets that would cross water, buildings or power line pylons, without leaving dead-end stubs.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.followTerrain.T: Roads follow the ground. Off: the whole network stays at the area's average height.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.edgeDepth.Toolt: How deep the strips along the new streets reach into each block (used by zoning and other add-ons).
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.streetTrees.Too: Trees along both sides of the streets.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.streetGrass.Too: Grass strips along the streets (not with wide sidewalks).
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.streetBikeLanes: Bike lanes on both sides of the streets.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.avenueTrees.Too: Trees along both sides of the avenues.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.avenueGrass.Too: Grass strips along both sides of the avenues.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.avenueBikeLanes: Bike lanes on both sides of the avenues.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Issue.NothingFits: No streets fit in this area with these settings. Try a larger area or smaller spacing.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Issue.TerrainFlat: The terrain here is flat: the contour pattern has no slope to follow.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Issue.ObstaclesAvoided: {0} road segments were left out to avoid water and buildings.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Issue.GenerationFailed: The streets could not be planned: {0}
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Issue.InvalidArea: The area outline is not valid.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Recipe.Roads.Description: A street pattern for the area, connected to the roads around it.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Recipe.RoadsWithParks.Descrip: Streets, with a park filling every block between them.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Recipe.RoadsWithZoning.Descri: Streets, with zoning painted along every new street.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.EdgeZoning.Name: Edge zoning
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Zone.Type.Tooltip: Which zone the plots get; buildings of that zone grow there.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Zone.commercialLow.Tooltip: Shops and small businesses (low density commercial).
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Zone.commercialHigh.Tooltip: Department stores and shop towers (high density commercial).
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Zone.mixed.Tooltip: Shops on the ground floor with flats above.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Zone.residentialMedium.Toolti: Apartment blocks of a few storeys.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.EdgeZoning.Control.cutout.Too: Set by the Zoning feature: zone the whole cutout, however deep.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.EdgeZoning.Control.zone.Toolt: A specific zone (mods included) instead of the zone type. Cells already zoned keep their zone.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.EdgeZoning.Control.depth.Tool: How deep the zoning reaches from the road (8 m per cell, 6 cells at most).
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.EdgeZoning.Issue.NoFrontage: No road runs along this area, so nothing was zoned.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.junctionSpacing: On main roads (avenues): side streets join at most this often (m). Closer side streets end in a cul-de-sac before the avenue (with a footpath to it) or join their neighbours instead. 0 = every side street joins.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.walkways.Toolti: Footpaths that shorten walks: from cul-de-sacs to the next street or close, through long blocks and through the middle of grid blocks. 0 = none.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.walkwayStyle.To: Paved footpaths, dirt trails (a trail path when your playset has one, with worn ground painted along it), or a mix.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Option.walkwayStyle.tra: Dirt or gravel trails with worn ground painted along them (terrain paint is permanent).
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.backLanes.Toolt: Small lanes through the middle of the blocks, between two parallel streets (share of the blocks that can take one). Never onto an avenue.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.laneStyle.Toolt: Paved alleys, gravel lanes, or a mix.
The Alley road (or the lane road you pick).
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.laneAsset.Toolt: Road used for back lanes. Automatic places the Alley.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.tipStyle.Toolti: The road of the dead-end streets: the same as their street, gravel, or gravel at some of them.
Every cul-de-sac is a gravel road from its last junction.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Option.tipStyle.mixed.T: About half of the cul-de-sacs are gravel roads.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.terrainFit.Tool: Follow contours lays the streets along the slope (grids bend onto the contour lines, winding streets steer by the hill, too-steep links go). Ignore terrain keeps the pattern strict whatever the ground does.
Each pattern as it is (its own Align to terrain option).
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Option.terrainFit.follo: Streets along the contour lines, gentle climbs between them.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Option.terrainFit.ignor: The strict pattern, straight over hills.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.landShape.Toolt: Terraced: on a hill every street's lots are levelled across the street, as deep as their zone cells, with a bank at the back of the lots up to the next level; the banks are painted and planted. Flat ground is never touched. Natural: the ground as it is.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Option.landShape.terrac: Level lots along every street, banks between the levels (sloped ground only).
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.maxGrade.Toolti: The grade the layout aims to stay under (%). Steeper roads are marked in Design; Follow contours removes too-steep links where it can.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.preZone.Tooltip: Zones every cell along every new road with this zone once the roads are built. Cells you zoned before keep their zone.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Issue.IslandsDropped: {0} road pieces ({1} m) could not be linked to the rest and were left out.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Issue.NotConnected: These roads could not be linked to the nearby roads: connect them yourself after building.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Issue.Steep: A road here climbs {0} %, steeper than the steepest road set for this layout.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Option.pattern.terraces: Streets on the hill's contour lines, each on a level terrace as deep as its zone cells, with banks between and links up the slope.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.terraceCells.To: Zone cells (8 m each) kept level on each side of a terrace street.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.terraceLinks.To: How the roads between terraces climb.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Option.terraceLinks.dir: Straight up where gentle enough, else a long diagonal; switchbacks only where nothing else fits.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Option.terraceLinks.ser: Zig-zag legs joined by hairpin bends, climbing gently between two terraces.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Option.terraceLinks.spi: One road winding round and up the hill, crossing every terrace.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.terraceLinkSpac: How far apart the links up the hill are along a terrace street.
The links up the hill are avenues instead of streets.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.terraceFall.Too: A gentle cross-fall away from the bank so rain drains off (0 = dead level).
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.terraceBank.Too: What stands between two levels: rounded grassy banks or steep straight faces.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Option.terraceBank.bank: A smooth S-shaped bank with rounded edges.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Option.terraceBank.wall: A straight steep face with crisp terrace edges, worn dirt on the face.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.terraceBankSlop: No bank between terraces is steeper than this (50 % = 1 in 2).
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.terraceFlat.Too: Ground already flatter than this is never terraced.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.terraceEarthwor: The deepest cut or highest fill the terraces may make.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.terracePaint.To: Dry grass and worn dirt on the banks (terrain paint is permanent).
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.terraceTrees.To: Clumps of trees on the banks between the terraces.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Issue.TerraceSteep: The hill is steeper than terraces this deep allow: they narrow in places. Fewer cells or a steeper bank fit better.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Issue.TerraceEarthwork: The earthwork is capped at {0} m: in places the terraces follow the hill a little.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Issue.TerraceFlat: The ground here is flat: the streets are laid in rows and nothing is terraced.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Issue.DroppedObstacle: Street left out: it would cross a building, water or a pylon and no way round fitted.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Issue.PerimeterBlocked: Perimeter piece left out: a building, water or a pylon sits on the outline and no way round fitted.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Issue.PerimeterOpen: The perimeter road does not close here: no clean way across the gap.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Issue.JunctionCut: Side street cut back from this main road: junctions here are kept this far apart.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.connectTo.Toolt: Which existing roads the new streets may join. Roads they may not join are never crossed either.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Option.connectTo.street: Every road except highways and their ramps.
Two-lane roads, lanes and gravel roads only: the big roads keep their junctions few.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Option.connectTo.any.To: Every road, highways and ramps too.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.gridCharacter.T: How perfect the grid stays. Strict: every street straight through, whatever the ground. Automatic: the grid gives way where the site asks (it bends on a hill, streets too steep for cars become steps, land too steep to build becomes a hillside park, a diagonal follows a desire line between two city streets when it is worth it). Lively: more of it, with staggered brick blocks and a square in the middle.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Option.gridCharacter.st: The plain grid: every street straight through.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Option.gridCharacter.au: The grid gives way to hills and desire lines, only where the site asks for it.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Option.gridCharacter.li: Staggered brick blocks, a square in the middle, a diagonal along a gentler desire line.
en-US.roads.json.Placemaker.Roads.Control.roadWear.Toolti: Paints the ground the new streets wear in: worn desire paths where people take shortcuts, worn corners at the junctions, dry verges along the streets. Paint stays when the roads are removed.
A few desire paths, light wear.

en-US.safety.json.Placemaker.Issue.CutoutNotZonable: A shop plot faces no road the game zones from. It is left to the park.
en-US.safety.json.Placemaker.Issue.BuildingsKept: {0} buildings are in the way. They are kept: nothing is built on their lots.
en-US.safety.json.Placemaker.Issue.BuildingsLeftOut: {0} parts were left out or cut back to keep clear of existing buildings.
en-US.safety.json.Placemaker.Problem.OnlyBuildings: Only things the brush rules keep off are under the paint (buildings, other builds, zoning, water). Paint somewhere else, or change the rules.
en-US.safety.json.Placemaker.Hint.BuildingsKept: {0} buildings in the selection stay: nothing is built on their lots.
Plain Paint cuts building lots out of the painted area (shaded red while painting). Off = the old behaviour: the outline covers buildings, and the build still leaves them standing.
en-US.safety.json.Placemaker.Why.AreaTooSmall: Needs a bigger area (at least {0} m²).

en-US.scrapyard.json.Placemaker.Scrapyard.Name: Scrapyard
en-US.scrapyard.json.Placemaker.Recipe.Scrapyard.Description: A fenced yard of scrap: haul loop, material bays, heaps, wrecks, containers or tyres, oily ground and a weighbridge at the gate.
en-US.scrapyard.json.Placemaker.Scrapyard.style.Tooltip: What the yard deals in. Each type has its own layout, not just different props.
en-US.scrapyard.json.Placemaker.Scrapyard.fill.Tooltip: How full the yard is: from a few tidy heaps to every corner crammed.
en-US.scrapyard.json.Placemaker.Scrapyard.aisle.Tooltip: Width of the haul loop and the aisles between rows and blocks.
en-US.scrapyard.json.Placemaker.Scrapyard.heapHeight.Tooltip: Raises real terrain under the big heaps so they read as mountains of scrap. 0 = flat. Permanent.
en-US.scrapyard.json.Placemaker.Scrapyard.machines.Tooltip: Material handlers, loaders, forklifts or reach stackers parked by the heaps and rows.
en-US.scrapyard.json.Placemaker.Scrapyard.strays.Tooltip: Single tyres, drums and bits of scrap lying about near the fence.
en-US.scrapyard.json.Placemaker.Scrapyard.visitorPaths.Toolti: Walkable aisles from the gate, for pick-your-own-part yards.
en-US.scrapyard.json.Placemaker.Scrapyard.overgrowth.Tooltip: Car graveyard: share of the yard left alone long enough for trees and bushes to grow through the wrecks.
en-US.scrapyard.json.Placemaker.Scrapyard.fence.Tooltip: A sound fence, none, or a broken one with missing panels.
en-US.scrapyard.json.Placemaker.Scrapyard.screenTrees.Tooltip: A belt of trees just inside the fence that hides the yard from the street.
en-US.scrapyard.json.Placemaker.Scrapyard.weeds.Tooltip: Scrubby bushes along the fence and in the corners.
en-US.scrapyard.json.Placemaker.Scrapyard.office.Tooltip: A site cabin beside the way in.
en-US.scrapyard.json.Placemaker.Scrapyard.weighbridge.Tooltip: A concrete weighbridge slab across the road just inside the gate.
en-US.scrapyard.json.Placemaker.Scrapyard.paint.Tooltip: Paints the terrain texture under heaps and machines (oil-soaked ground). Permanent.
en-US.scrapyard.json.Placemaker.Scrapyard.paintLayer.Tooltip: Which of the map's terrain textures (1–4) to paint with.
en-US.scrapyard.json.Placemaker.Scrapyard.level.Tooltip: Levels the yard to one pad, blended back to the ground at the outline. Permanent.
en-US.scrapyard.json.Placemaker.Scrapyard.grime.Tooltip: Oil, dirt, puddle and crack decals per 100 m², gathered round heaps, machines and roads.
en-US.scrapyard.json.Placemaker.Scrapyard.Issue.NoCore: The yard is too small for a central scrap heap; only the edge bays were filled.
en-US.scrapyard.json.Placemaker.AddOn.JunkPiles.Name: Junk piles
en-US.scrapyard.json.Placemaker.AddOn.JunkPiles.mix.Tooltip: What the piles are made of.
en-US.scrapyard.json.Placemaker.AddOn.JunkPiles.grime.Tooltip: Oil and dirt decals round the foot of each pile.
en-US.scrapyard.json.Placemaker.AddOn.JunkPiles.strays.Toolti: A few items that rolled off each pile.

en-US.shore.json.Placemaker.Feature.shore.Tooltip: Switches itself on when the area is partly in water or runs along it: piers, a filled quay, a promenade or a natural edge along the waterline. Away from water it does nothing.
en-US.shore.json.Placemaker.Shore.Issue.TooWet: Almost all of the area is water, so there is no dry ground left for the shore.
en-US.shore.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Shore.Name: Shore
en-US.shore.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Shore.style.Tooltip: How the waterline is built. Automatic turns the middle into a quay with a pier and the rest into a promenade.
en-US.shore.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Shore.bandWidth.Tooltip: How deep the shore strip on land is (promenade, quay apron, sand).
en-US.shore.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Shore.connect.Tooltip: Joins the waterside walk to the nearest paths of the park or square.
en-US.shore.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Shore.piers.Tooltip: Piers reaching out over the water. They need water inside the area.
en-US.shore.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Shore.pierHeads.Tooltip: A cross deck at the end of each pier, with benches looking out.
en-US.shore.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Shore.wharfDepth.Toolti: How far the quay is built out into the water. The water is filled in permanently.
en-US.shore.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Shore.wharfShare.Toolti: How much of the shoreline becomes quay.
en-US.shore.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Shore.boats.Tooltip: Boats moored at the quay and the piers, or pulled up on a beach.
en-US.shore.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Shore.cargo.Tooltip: Small groups of crates, barrels and nets on the quay.
en-US.shore.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Shore.reedDensity.Toolt: Clumps of reeds along the waterline and in the shallows.
en-US.shore.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Shore.Issue.NoWater: Shore: no water in or next to this area, so nothing was built.
en-US.shore.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Shore.Issue.WharfNeedsW: Shore: a quay is built out into water inside the area. Draw the area over the water to get one; a quay edge was made instead.
en-US.shore.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Shore.Issue.PiersNeedWa: Shore: piers need water inside the area. Draw the area over the water.
en-US.shore.json.Placemaker.Pond.islands.Tooltip: Islands in the open water, raised above it and planted. Fewer fit in a small pond.
en-US.shore.json.Placemaker.Pond.bridges.Tooltip: Arched footbridges from each island to the shore and between close islands.
en-US.shore.json.Placemaker.Pond.jets.Tooltip: Fountain jets in the open water.
en-US.shore.json.Placemaker.Pond.boathouse.Tooltip: A boathouse at the water's edge with a jetty and rowing boats.
en-US.shore.json.Placemaker.Pond.rowboats.Tooltip: Extra rowing boats out on the water.
en-US.shore.json.Placemaker.Pond.promenade.Tooltip: A paved walk all round the water with benches and lamps.
en-US.shore.json.Placemaker.Pond.connect.Tooltip: Joins the promenade, bridges and boathouse to the park's paths.
en-US.shore.json.Placemaker.Pond.Issue.NoPromenade: Pond: too small for a promenade round it.
en-US.shore.json.Placemaker.Pond.Issue.NoBoathouse: Pond: no free bank for the boathouse.

en-US.split.json.Placemaker.Recipe.SplitParkPlaza.Descrip: Divides the area: a park on one side, a plaza on the other. Drag the divider or the slider.
en-US.split.json.Placemaker.Split.Name: Split
en-US.split.json.Placemaker.Split.cuts.Tooltip: Click two points on the outline to draw a dividing line (two more for a second line). Without a divider, the sliders decide.
en-US.split.json.Placemaker.Split.ratio.Tooltip: Share of the area that goes to the first part.
en-US.split.json.Placemaker.Split.angle.Tooltip: 0° cuts across the long side; 90° cuts lengthwise.
en-US.split.json.Placemaker.Split.divider.Tooltip: Adds a footpath along each dividing line.
en-US.split.json.Placemaker.Split.Issue.CannotSplit: The area could not be divided this way, so it was kept whole.
en-US.split.json.Placemaker.Split.Issue.UnpairedMarker: A divider needs two points on the outline; the last point is ignored.

en-US.sportsPark.json.Placemaker.Sports.subtype.Tooltip: What kind of sports park this is. Presets set it with fitting facilities and landscape.
en-US.sportsPark.json.Placemaker.Sports.hero.Tooltip: The centrepiece: it takes the best spot with generous room around it, the spectator terrace and the clubhouse. Auto = the biggest field that is on.
en-US.sportsPark.json.Placemaker.Sports.spacing.Tooltip: Room between facilities, the tree belt and the paths. Distances also grow with the size of the park.
en-US.sportsPark.json.Placemaker.Sports.fieldAxis.Tooltip: Long fields run along the park's longest edge, or north–south / east–west (fewer players blinded by a low sun).
en-US.sportsPark.json.Placemaker.Sports.pitchSize.Tooltip: Pitch format. Auto picks the biggest that leaves room for everything else.
en-US.sportsPark.json.Placemaker.Sports.tennisCourtsCount.Tool: Fenced blocks of courts, set shoulder to shoulder.
en-US.sportsPark.json.Placemaker.Sports.tennisCourtsSize.Toolt: Courts side by side in one fenced block.
en-US.sportsPark.json.Placemaker.Sports.changingHut.Tooltip: A changing pavilion with toilets behind the spectator terrace, next to the main field.
en-US.sportsPark.json.Placemaker.Sports.terrace.Tooltip: A paved terrace along the main field with a touchline walk and rows of benches.
en-US.sportsPark.json.Placemaker.Sports.kiosk.Tooltip: A refreshment kiosk beside the clubhouse.
en-US.sportsPark.json.Placemaker.Sports.promenade.Tooltip: A jogging loop inside the tree belt, a tree-lined spine from the entrance to the clubhouse, or both.
en-US.sportsPark.json.Placemaker.Sports.entrancePlaza.Tooltip: A paved forecourt at the main entrance with bike racks, a noticeboard and bins.
en-US.sportsPark.json.Placemaker.Sports.bikeRacks.Tooltip: Bike racks on the entrance plaza.
en-US.sportsPark.json.Placemaker.Sports.treeBelt.Tooltip: Trees along the outline, outside the promenade loop.
en-US.sportsPark.json.Placemaker.Sports.treeDensity.Tooltip: Groves between the facilities: tree groups with open lawn between them.
en-US.sportsPark.json.Placemaker.Sports.berms.Tooltip: Low planted earth berms in the larger gaps between zones (permanent terrain change).
en-US.sportsPark.json.Placemaker.Sports.parking.Tooltip: A tidy car park on the street side next to the main entrance. Auto: only for parks of 2.5 ha or more with road frontage.
en-US.sportsPark.json.Placemaker.Sports.lotShare.Tooltip: Share of the park given to the car park.
en-US.sportsPark.json.Placemaker.Sports.tennisSurface.Tooltip: What the tennis courts are laid in: hard courts, clay (a club look) or grass.

en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Mode.Draw.Tooltip: Click corners. Snaps to curbs, buildings and right angles.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Mode.Block.Tooltip: Click a city block to fill it. Shift+click adds more.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Mode.Paint.Tooltip: Brush it on, freely (Smart edges off). Right-click erases.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Mode.Perimeter.Tooltip: Click road corners around the area; the roads between are followed.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Mode.BlockPaint.Tooltip: Brush it on; it stops at roads, buildings, zoning and water (Smart edges). Right-click erases.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Painter.Name: Outgrow gardens
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Painter.Desc: Join up the gardens of the houses you pick, or put them back as the game made them.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Painter.CityPolishing: Outgrowing the whole city, a few buildings at a time
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Painter.CityUnpolishing: Removing outgrow from the whole city, a few hundred at a time
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Painter.Paused: Outgrow is switched off for this city: they outgrow once you switch it back on
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Problem.TooManyPoints: That is the most corners an outline can have.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Problem.NeedThreePoints: An area needs at least three corners.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Problem.TooSmallFor: Too small for this design (at least {0} m²).
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Problem.TooLargeFor: Too large for this design (at most {0} m²).
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Problem.OnOtherBuild: This outline lies on another Placemaker build. Move it, or turn off the brush rule "Other builds".
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Problem.NoBlockHere: No block could be found here.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Problem.BlockFull: Nothing to paint in this block: it is zoned, built on or under water.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Problem.CannotPaintHere: Nothing can be painted here: it is a road, zoned, built on or under water.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Problem.NoRoadsNearby: No roads nearby. Use Draw or Paint here.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Problem.NotEnclosed: Not enclosed here. Turn on more walls (paths, tracks…) or use Points.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Problem.BlockTooLarge: This block is too large to pick. Use Draw or Paint.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Problem.NotAdjacent: Only blocks next to the selection can be added.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Problem.WouldEncloseHole: Areas cannot have holes: that would enclose a block you did not pick.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Problem.WouldSplit: Removing that block would split the selection in two.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Problem.PerimeterClosed: The loop is closed. Right-click to reopen it.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Problem.NoRoadPath: These intersections are not connected by roads.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Problem.NodeAlreadyUsed: The loop already passes through there.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Problem.SaveFailed: The design could not be saved.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Problem.CannotDeleteRecipe: Only your own designs can be deleted.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Problem.PresetSaveFailed: The preset could not be saved.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Problem.CannotRenamePreset: Only your own presets can be renamed.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Problem.CannotEdit: This area cannot be edited (its design was not stored).
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Hint.BlockReplace: Click elsewhere to fill there instead
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Hint.DefaultsSaved: Saved as the default for this layer.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Hint.Ungrouped: Ungrouped: click its pieces one by one.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Hint.Grouped: Grouped again: one click selects all of it.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Issue.PlanFailed: The layout could not be planned: {0}
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Issue.PlanTimeout: Planning took longer than {0} s and was stopped. Try a smaller area.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Issue.KeptOffRoads: The area was trimmed to keep off existing roads ({0} m² left out).
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Issue.AreaSplitByRoad: A road runs through the area: the largest part is used, {0} smaller part(s) ({1} m²) left out. Select them separately if you want them too.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Issue.BuildFailedNext: Red circles show where it went wrong. Adjust the outline or the settings and build again, or go back. The circles disappear as soon as you change something.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Permanent.Terraform: Reshapes the ground (about {0} m²). This stays even if you remove the build later.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Permanent.Water: Digs a pond or lake (about {0} m²). The hollow stays even if you remove the build later.
On: outgrown buildings' gardens join up with their neighbours: one plot each, shared fences and hedges, lawns or painted ground up to them, planting, paths and garden features by theme. Off: nothing is changed from now on; gardens already outgrown stay as they are (Remove all outgrow puts them back). Switching it on never redoes the whole city.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Settings.PolishStatus.Desc: How many buildings in this city are outgrown, and what is still being worked on. Changing a setting below never changes the whole city at once: new buildings get it, the painter (Outgrow gardens in Placemaker) gives it to an area, and Redo outgrown buildings gives it to every outgrown building, a few at a time.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Settings.PolishStatus.NoCity: Open a city to see how many buildings are outgrown.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Settings.PolishStatus.Working: working through {0:N0}, a few at a time
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Settings.PolishStatus.Changed: settings changed: new buildings get them, Redo outgrown buildings gives them to the rest
Outgrows every house, shop, office and works already standing in this city (not the kinds set to Off), each with its kind's theme. It runs in the background a few buildings at a time, so the game keeps running smoothly; in a big city it takes a few minutes. Remove all outgrow puts it back.
Outgrow every building in this city? It runs in the background a few buildings at a time; in a big city it can take several minutes.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Settings.RedoPolishedBuilding: Fits every outgrown building again with the settings above and gives it its kind's theme (buildings you gave a theme with the painter keep it). It runs in the background a few buildings at a time.
Redo every outgrown building with these settings? It runs in the background a few buildings at a time; in a big city it can take several minutes.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Settings.PolishNewHouses.Desc: Buildings that grow from now on are outgrown, each with its kind's theme below. Off: they stay as the game made them. Buildings already standing: Outgrow every building below, or Outgrow gardens in Placemaker for an area.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Settings.RemoveAllPolish.Desc: Puts every garden in this city back as the game made it: fences, hedges and lawns go back, and the beds, paths, bushes and paving that outgrow added are taken away. Ground paint stays. It runs in the background a few hundred buildings at a time.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Settings.RemoveAllPolish.Warn: Put every garden in this city back as the game made it? It runs in the background a few hundred buildings at a time.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Settings.PolishThemeHomes.Des: How the gardens of homes are dressed when they are outgrown. Garden: lawns, beds, now and then a sand pit or a bench. Natural: painted ground instead of lawn, rock outcrops, logs, meadow. Tidy: lawns, hedges and flower beds, no rocks. Yard: worn ground, rubble, pallets and crates. Off: new homes are not outgrown. The painter can give any house its own theme. A change is given to homes outgrown from now on; Redo outgrown buildings gives it to the ones already outgrown.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Settings.PolishThemeShops.Des: How shops are dressed when outgrown (the gaps between them are paved with their own paving whatever the theme). Off: new shops are not outgrown. A change is given to shops outgrown from now on; Redo outgrown buildings gives it to the ones already outgrown.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Settings.PolishThemeOffices.D: How offices are dressed when outgrown. Off: new offices are not outgrown. A change is given to offices outgrown from now on; Redo outgrown buildings gives it to the ones already outgrown.
How industry is dressed when outgrown: Yard gives storage yards, rubble and worn ground. Off: new industry is not outgrown. A change is given to industry outgrown from now on; Redo outgrown buildings gives it to the ones already outgrown.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Settings.PolishLawns.Desc: A garden's lawn grows to its new fences, around driveways and paving. Off: only the fences and hedges are joined.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Settings.PolishPaintedGardens: How many gardens are painted (lush ground with soft edges) instead of keeping lawns: their own grass is tucked away and the whole garden is painted, paving kept. Natural and Yard buildings are painted more often, Tidy ones seldom; 0 never, 100 always. A mix looks more like a real street.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Settings.PolishPavedFill.Desc: Shops, offices and works fill the land between them with the surface most of their ground already is (their car park or concrete), not lawn.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Settings.PolishPlanting.Desc: Planted beds with bushes along some of the new fences and hedges. They belong to the house and go with it.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Settings.PolishFeatures.Desc: Big new garden land gets something in it now and then: a rock garden, a sand pit, a wild corner with logs, or a bench with a flower bed. Next to industry, a storage yard with rubble, pallets and crates.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Settings.PolishPaths.Desc: A paved path through some big gardens, and a walkway between some houses with a narrow gap.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Settings.PolishRocks.Desc: Now and then a rock by the street where two gardens meet (never against a hedge).
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Settings.PolishGroundPaint.De: Soft lush ground past the gardens' edges, blending them into the land around, and worn ground along fences that face open land. Paint stays on the ground when a house is bulldozed.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Settings.BrushPaintOverAnythi: Paint area paints over roads, buildings, zoning and water, ignoring the stops below.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Settings.BrushStopRoads.Desc: The brush stops at the curb and never paints across a road.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Settings.BrushStopBuildings.D: The brush keeps off building lots.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Settings.BrushStopBuilds.Desc: Every area tool keeps off what you built with Placemaker (except the one being edited).
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Settings.BrushStopLots.Desc: The brush keeps off parks, other mods' lots and lot areas.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Settings.BrushStopZoned.Desc: The brush keeps off zoned cells that have a building (or one being built). Vacant zoned land stays paintable.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Settings.BrushStopAllZoned.De: The brush also keeps off zoned cells nobody has built on yet.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Settings.BlockPaintAvoidEmpty: The brush also keeps the empty zone grid free.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Settings.BrushStopWater.Desc: The brush keeps off water deeper than wading depth.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Settings.BrushStayInBlock.Des: A Paint area stroke stays inside the block where it started.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Settings.BrushDrawClip.Desc: Points, Paint bucket and Road nodes outlines are cut back to free land using the stops above.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Settings.BrushSnapDistance.De: Painted edges this close to a curb or obstacle snap onto it; 0 = off.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Settings.BrushSmoothing.Desc: How smooth the painted edge is: 0 keeps the brush cells, 6 is smoothest.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Settings.ResetBrushRules.Desc: Puts every edge rule back to its default.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Settings.ClearExistingTreesAn: Removes trees, plants, props and decals inside the area when it is built, so nothing old pokes through. Buildings, utilities and roads are never touched.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Settings.KeepZonedBuildingsOf: Blocks the roads' zone cells under a park, plaza or other build (except its zoning cutouts), so the city cannot grow houses or shops on it. Removing the build unblocks them again. Off: the land under a build stays zonable.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Settings.RecoverRejectedPiece: If the game refuses some pieces, repair or leave out just those and build the rest. Placemaker tells you what was skipped.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Settings.OverlayPavedSurfaces: Paving, asphalt and plaza surfaces are drawn on top of grass instead of flickering with it.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Settings.DecalsNeverCollide.D: Leaves, stains and other ground decals lie under trees, benches and paths instead of being hidden where they overlap. Turn off if decals do not show.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Settings.ChargeNetConstructio: Roads and paths cost what the game charges for them, like when you draw them yourself.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Settings.SelectAsOneThing: Select and bulldoze as one thing
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Settings.SelectAsOneThing.Des: Clicking any part of a built lot, park or plaza selects the whole build; bulldozing removes it all. Applies to new builds.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Settings.DebugTerrainDump.Des: After every build, writes the terrain heights before and after, the water depth and the built paths and objects around it to ModsData/Placemaker/debug as a JSON file, for checking the result offline (the gallery renders it). Off normally.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Settings.ConfirmBulldoze: Ask before bulldozing a whole build
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Settings.ConfirmBulldoze.Desc: Shows the game's confirmation before a Placemaker build is bulldozed.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Settings.AutoExcludeCollision: Only when collisions are not ignored: decorative pieces the game refuses are left out (listed in the build report) instead of refusing the whole build.
Build everything you planned, like the Anarchy mod: the game's overlap and shape checks never refuse or remove pieces of a Placemaker build. Existing buildings are never demolished.

en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Settings.ParkingEconomy.Desc: Parking lots built with Placemaker charge a parking fee and count as parking in the city.

en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Settings.CompanionUpkeepFacto: Multiplies the upkeep of the parking lot service building.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Settings.ShowCursorTooltips.D: Show what a click does and the area size next to the cursor.

en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Settings.PrimaryBinding.Desc: Does what the main button says (next step, build…).
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Settings.UndoBinding.Desc: Undo the last change to the area or design.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Settings.RemoveEverything.Des: Removes every park, plaza, parking lot and road area built with Placemaker in this city.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Settings.RemoveEverything.War: Remove everything Placemaker built in this city? This cannot be undone.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Settings.ResetDefaults.Desc: Resets these options and forgets the layer defaults you saved.
en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Settings.ResetDefaults.Warnin: Reset all Placemaker options and saved layer defaults?

en-US.tool.json.Placemaker.Settings.BrushStopBikes.Desc: Points, Paint bucket and Paint area keep off bike paths.

en-US.urbanRuins.json.Placemaker.Ruins.subtype.Tooltip: What the ruins became. Each type lays the spot out differently.
en-US.urbanRuins.json.Placemaker.Ruins.skateItems.Tooltip: Ramps, rails and boxes in lines on the pads under the highway; ramps at the ends face in.
en-US.urbanRuins.json.Placemaker.Ruins.graffiti.Tooltip: Graffiti on pillars, walls, blocks and along the pads.
en-US.urbanRuins.json.Placemaker.Ruins.decay.Tooltip: How ruined it is: rubble on the fallen spans, cracks, faded markings.
en-US.urbanRuins.json.Placemaker.Ruins.overgrowth.Tooltip: Wild plants reclaiming the edges and the fallen deck.
en-US.urbanRuins.json.Placemaker.Ruins.deck.Tooltip: The old highway line: pillar pairs, spans that stand or have fallen.
en-US.urbanRuins.json.Placemaker.Ruins.deckSide.Tooltip: Through the middle, or along one side leaving a big yard.
en-US.urbanRuins.json.Placemaker.Ruins.collapse.Tooltip: Share of spans that fell: broken asphalt, tilted slabs and rubble on the ground, stumps for pillars.
en-US.urbanRuins.json.Placemaker.Ruins.embankment.Tooltip: An earth on-ramp rising towards a broken-off end (permanent terraform).
en-US.urbanRuins.json.Placemaker.Ruins.markings.Tooltip: Faded lane markings on the fallen carriageway.
en-US.urbanRuins.json.Placemaker.Ruins.padShare.Tooltip: Concrete pads under the standing spans where the skaters built their spot.
en-US.urbanRuins.json.Placemaker.Ruins.ledges.Tooltip: Concrete blocks and barriers dragged onto the pads as ledges.
en-US.urbanRuins.json.Placemaker.Ruins.bowl.Tooltip: A dug bowl in a pad (permanent terraform). 0 = none.
en-US.urbanRuins.json.Placemaker.Ruins.jumpLines.Tooltip: BMX dirt-jump lines (take-off and landing mounds) in the yard.
en-US.urbanRuins.json.Placemaker.Ruins.blocks.Tooltip: A field of concrete blocks of different sizes on gravel.
en-US.urbanRuins.json.Placemaker.Ruins.walls.Tooltip: Free-standing legal walls in a zig-zag row, painted on both sides.
en-US.urbanRuins.json.Placemaker.Ruins.fenceGaps.Tooltip: Share of fence panels that are missing.
en-US.urbanRuins.json.Placemaker.Ruins.Issue.NoDeck: The area is too narrow for the highway line.
en-US.urbanRuins.json.Placemaker.Ruins.Issue.Fewer: Only {0} of {1} fit in the yard.
en-US.urbanRuins.json.Placemaker.AddOn.DirtJumps.Name: Dirt jumps
en-US.urbanRuins.json.Placemaker.AddOn.DirtJumps.height.Toolti: Height of the take-off mounds (permanent terraform).
en-US.urbanRuins.json.Placemaker.AddOn.DirtJumps.jumps.Tooltip: Take-off/landing pairs per line (fewer when they do not fit).
en-US.urbanRuins.json.Placemaker.AddOn.DirtJumps.startHill.Too: A taller hill at the start of each line to build speed.
en-US.urbanRuins.json.Placemaker.AddOn.DirtJumps.paintLayer.To: Which of the map's four extra terrain textures to paint.
en-US.urbanRuins.json.Placemaker.AddOn.DirtJumps.Issue.NoPlace: No free ground was big enough for the dirt jumps.

en-US.waterfront.json.Placemaker.Waterfront.Name: Waterfront
en-US.waterfront.json.Placemaker.Recipe.Waterfront.Description: A designed edge to the water, fitted to the terrain: a quay, walkway quay, boardwalk or natural bank at the water, a smooth embankment up to one level promenade with benches facing the water, lamps, planted beds and trees, piers from landings, step flights down to the river. Cliffs stay natural, with a cliff-top walk.
en-US.waterfront.json.Placemaker.Waterfront.style.Tooltip: Promenade boardwalk, pier park, harbour quay, river steps or natural bank: each sets the water edge, the promenade and the planting.
en-US.waterfront.json.Placemaker.Waterfront.waterSide.Tooltip: Which side of the area faces the water. Automatic finds the water; otherwise pick a side (north = +Z on the map).
en-US.waterfront.json.Placemaker.Waterfront.promWidth.Tooltip: Distance from the water to the promenade (on a harbour quay: the depth of the paved apron behind the quay).
en-US.waterfront.json.Placemaker.Waterfront.railings.Tooltip: One continuous railing along the promenade's water edge, only where the ground there drops more than 1 m (quays and piers bring their own).
en-US.waterfront.json.Placemaker.Waterfront.lampSpacing.Toolti: Lamps along the water side of the walk. 0 = none.
en-US.waterfront.json.Placemaker.Waterfront.moorings.Tooltip: Bollards along the quay edge, as in a harbor.
en-US.waterfront.json.Placemaker.Waterfront.riprap.Tooltip: Rocks along the waterline (riprap), for a natural bank.
en-US.waterfront.json.Placemaker.Waterfront.steps.Tooltip: Paved flights on the smooth bank from the promenade down to the walkway quay: a few spots, or regularly along the whole edge.
en-US.waterfront.json.Placemaker.Waterfront.stepLevels.Tooltip: Unused since s30: the flights lie on the smooth bank (no terraces).
en-US.waterfront.json.Placemaker.Waterfront.piers.Tooltip: Piers built as paths out over the water. They reach past the outline over the water when the area is drawn along the shore.
en-US.waterfront.json.Placemaker.Waterfront.pierHeads.Tooltip: A cross walk at the end of each pier.
en-US.waterfront.json.Placemaker.Waterfront.fishing.Tooltip: Spots along the edge with fishing props, a seat and a bin.
en-US.waterfront.json.Placemaker.Waterfront.nautical.Tooltip: Life rings by the edge, anchors, buoys and crates along the walk.
en-US.waterfront.json.Placemaker.Waterfront.trees.Tooltip: A tree row, or a double row (avenue), behind the promenade.
en-US.waterfront.json.Placemaker.Waterfront.backdrop.Tooltip: What fills the land behind the promenade: a lawn, a planted park, or nothing.
en-US.waterfront.json.Placemaker.Waterfront.shoreTexture.Toolt: Paint a soft sand or dirt band into the terrain at the water’s edge (permanent). Automatic: sand for promenades and piers, dirt for fishing banks, none for quays.
en-US.waterfront.json.Placemaker.Waterfront.Issue.PiersNeedWat: Piers need water beside or inside the area: draw it along the shore or out over the water.
en-US.waterfront.json.Placemaker.Waterfront.edge.Tooltip: What meets the water: a wide quay (stone wall, deck above the water), a walkway quay, a timber boardwalk just off the bank, or a natural bank graded into the water. Automatic picks by type.
en-US.waterfront.json.Placemaker.Waterfront.deckHeight.Tooltip: Height of the quay or boardwalk deck above the water. The land behind a quay is filled to this level (permanent).
en-US.waterfront.json.Placemaker.Waterfront.beds.Tooltip: Beds of low flowering shrubs in the bays behind the promenade.
en-US.waterfront.json.Placemaker.Waterfront.hillside.Tooltip: Where the level promenade is cut into rising ground: a retaining wall along its land edge (as when a road is built into a slope), a graded grass bank back up to the ground, or automatic (a wall when the cut is between 1.5 m and the wall height limit, else a bank).
en-US.waterfront.json.Placemaker.Waterfront.maxWall.Tooltip: Highest retaining wall allowed along the promenade's land side; a taller cut gets a graded bank instead.
en-US.waterfront.json.Placemaker.Waterfront.Issue.WallTooHigh: The hillside behind the promenade rises {0} m, above the {1} m wall limit: graded as a bank instead.

en-US.wetland.json.Placemaker.Recipe.Wetland.Description: Shallow ponds with boardwalks, islands, reed beds and bird hides.
en-US.wetland.json.Placemaker.Wetland.Name: Wetland
en-US.wetland.json.Placemaker.Wetland.subtype.Tooltip: How the wetland is composed: ponds and trails, a water garden, a reed marsh, rain-garden swales or a bird reserve.
en-US.wetland.json.Placemaker.Wetland.waterCover.Tooltip: Share of the area that becomes open water. Ponds only grow where the trails leave room.
en-US.wetland.json.Placemaker.Wetland.ponds.Tooltip: How many separate ponds the water is split into.
en-US.wetland.json.Placemaker.Wetland.depth.Tooltip: Depth of the open water below the water level. Wetlands are shallow: around 1 m.
en-US.wetland.json.Placemaker.Wetland.islands.Tooltip: Wild islands left in the larger ponds, with a channel all round, for nesting birds.
en-US.wetland.json.Placemaker.Wetland.shelf.Tooltip: A shallow shelf along the shore where reeds stand in the water, before the deeper middle.
en-US.wetland.json.Placemaker.Wetland.boardwalks.Tooltip: Walks across the water from trail to trail, or out to a platform. The ground under them stays dry.
en-US.wetland.json.Placemaker.Wetland.zigzag.Tooltip: Long boardwalks zig-zag over the water instead of running straight.
en-US.wetland.json.Placemaker.Wetland.terrace.Tooltip: A small paved terrace on the bank with benches facing the water.
en-US.wetland.json.Placemaker.Wetland.boardwalkAsset.Toolti: Path used across the water; pick a wooden path for a real boardwalk look.
en-US.wetland.json.Placemaker.Wetland.reeds.Tooltip: How densely reeds are massed along the shores, in clumps.
en-US.wetland.json.Placemaker.Wetland.reedBelt.Tooltip: How far up the bank the reed beds reach.
en-US.wetland.json.Placemaker.Wetland.screen.Tooltip: A belt of trees along the outline that screens the water from the street.
en-US.wetland.json.Placemaker.Wetland.hides.Tooltip: Hides on the bank facing the islands, or at the end of a boardwalk spur.
en-US.wetland.json.Placemaker.Wetland.lookout.Tooltip: A lookout beside a trail with the best view over the water.
en-US.wetland.json.Placemaker.Wetland.animals.Tooltip: Adds animal spawners on dry ground.
en-US.wetland.json.Placemaker.Wetland.marshPaint.Tooltip: Paints the banks around the water with a terrain texture (permanent).
en-US.wetland.json.Placemaker.Wetland.marshLayer.Tooltip: Which of the map's extra terrain textures (1–4) the banks get.
en-US.wetland.json.Placemaker.Wetland.hummocks.Tooltip: Height of gentle mounds on dry ground away from the water (0 = flat). Blended to the original ground at the outline.
en-US.wetland.json.Placemaker.Wetland.Issue.WaterPermanent: The ponds are dug into the terrain and filled with water. This is permanent: removing the wetland does not restore the ground.
en-US.wetland.json.Placemaker.Wetland.Issue.NoRoom: No room for ponds between the trails. Make the area larger or use fewer entrances.
en-US.wetland.json.Placemaker.Wetland.Issue.FewerPonds: Only {0} of {1} ponds fit between the trails.
en-US.wetland.json.Placemaker.Wetland.Issue.FewerHides: Only {0} of {1} bird hides found a spot on the banks.
en-US.wetland.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Wildlife.Name: Wildlife habitat
en-US.wetland.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Wildlife.corners.Toolti: Quiet corners that get nest boxes, a log and stone pile and wildlife.
en-US.wetland.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Wildlife.quiet.Tooltip: How far from any path a habitat corner must be.
en-US.wetland.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Wildlife.nestBoxes.Tool: Bird or bat boxes and insect hotels.
en-US.wetland.json.Placemaker.AddOn.Wildlife.piles.Tooltip: A few small stones piled for insects and amphibians.

en-US.zenGarden.json.Placemaker.Recipe.ZenGarden.Description: Raked gravel, rock groupings, a pond with bridges, lanterns and stepping stones.
en-US.zenGarden.json.Placemaker.Zen.Name: Zen garden
en-US.zenGarden.json.Placemaker.Zen.style.Tooltip: Dry rock garden, pond stroll garden, tea garden, moss garden or bamboo grove.
en-US.zenGarden.json.Placemaker.Zen.gravel.Tooltip: Share of the inner garden given to the raked gravel field (0 = none).
en-US.zenGarden.json.Placemaker.Zen.pond.Tooltip: A pond in the inner garden with bridges and islands. Digging it is permanent.
en-US.zenGarden.json.Placemaker.Zen.fieldShape.Tooltip: A crisp rectangle (temple garden) or a soft organic outline.
en-US.zenGarden.json.Placemaker.Zen.raking.Tooltip: Raked patterns painted into the gravel: straight lines, ripples around the rocks, or both.
en-US.zenGarden.json.Placemaker.Zen.gravelLayer.Tooltip: Which of the map's extra terrain textures (1–4) the gravel field gets (permanent paint).
en-US.zenGarden.json.Placemaker.Zen.rakeLayer.Tooltip: Texture (1–4) of the raked strokes; pick one that contrasts with the gravel.
en-US.zenGarden.json.Placemaker.Zen.gravelSurface.Tooltip: Lay a gravel or sand surface instead of painting the terrain (no raking then).
en-US.zenGarden.json.Placemaker.Zen.rockGroups.Tooltip: Number of rock groupings — always odd, never symmetric.
en-US.zenGarden.json.Placemaker.Zen.groupSize.Tooltip: Stones in each group: threes, fives, or the classic mixed 5-3-3-1-3 rhythm.
en-US.zenGarden.json.Placemaker.Zen.mossRings.Tooltip: Moss painted under the rock groups in the gravel.
en-US.zenGarden.json.Placemaker.Zen.pondSize.Tooltip: Share of the area the pond aims for.
en-US.zenGarden.json.Placemaker.Zen.bridgeStyle.Tooltip: Zig-zag plank bridges (yatsuhashi) or straight crossings.
en-US.zenGarden.json.Placemaker.Zen.islands.Tooltip: Crane and turtle islands, each with a pine.
en-US.zenGarden.json.Placemaker.Zen.steppingStones.Tooltip: Stepping-stone trails through the moss and to the tea house.
en-US.zenGarden.json.Placemaker.Zen.prunedTrees.Tooltip: Specimen pines, maples and cherries per hectare.
en-US.zenGarden.json.Placemaker.Zen.shrubs.Tooltip: Clipped shrub mounds per hectare, set in groups of three or five.
en-US.zenGarden.json.Placemaker.Zen.bamboo.Tooltip: A bamboo screen along the outline, or a whole bamboo grove.
en-US.zenGarden.json.Placemaker.Zen.mossPaint.Tooltip: Paints the inner garden with a terrain texture (permanent).
en-US.zenGarden.json.Placemaker.Zen.lanterns.Tooltip: Lanterns at bridge ends, entrances, the shore and the rock groups.
en-US.zenGarden.json.Placemaker.Zen.teaHouse.Tooltip: A tea house on the quietest spot, with a waiting bench, basin and stepping stones.
en-US.zenGarden.json.Placemaker.Zen.basin.Tooltip: A stone water basin (tsukubai) with a lantern beside it.
en-US.zenGarden.json.Placemaker.Zen.wall.Tooltip: A wall or fence around the garden, open at the entrances.
en-US.zenGarden.json.Placemaker.Zen.Issue.PondPermanent: The pond is dug into the terrain and filled with water. This is permanent: removing the garden does not restore the ground.
en-US.zenGarden.json.Placemaker.Zen.Issue.NoField: The gravel field did not fit in the inner garden. Lower the gravel share or enlarge the area.
en-US.zenGarden.json.Placemaker.Zen.Issue.NoPond: No room for the pond inside the stroll loop.
en-US.zenGarden.json.Placemaker.Zen.Issue.NoTeaHouse: No quiet spot was large enough for the tea house.
en-US.zenGarden.json.Placemaker.Zen.Issue.FewerGroups: Only {0} of {1} rock groups found a place.
en-US.zenGarden.json.Placemaker.AddOn.TeaHouse.Name: Tea house
en-US.zenGarden.json.Placemaker.AddOn.TeaHouse.bench.Tooltip: A bench on the way in, where guests wait to be called.
en-US.zenGarden.json.Placemaker.AddOn.TeaHouse.basin.Tooltip: A stone basin by the entrance for washing hands.
en-US.zenGarden.json.Placemaker.AddOn.TeaHouse.stones.Tooltip: Stepping stones from the nearest path to the door.
